jobs.title: CDL Driver/ Equipment Operator
jobs.description: Company: Delco Storm and Sewer Position: CDL A Driver/Equipment Operator Location: Lansdowne, PA Pay: Competitive pay and compensation structure based off of experience Schedule: Monday - Friday 7am - 4pm; occasional weekends for emergency jobs Delco Storm & Sewer Services is a trusted name in sewer and stormwater solutions with decades of experience serving residential, commercial, and municipal clients. We are seeking a dependable, safety-minded CDL A Driver/Equipment Operator—to join our growing field operations team. This hybrid role requires a confident professional who can safely operate heavy trucks and various types of earth-moving equipment. The ideal candidate is safety-conscious, physically capable, and experienced with excavation and site work. Key Responsibilities: Safely operate 6-wheel and triaxle dump trucks with air brakes. Haul heavy equipment using trailers; secure and transport earth-moving machinery. Operate excavators, skid steers, loaders, and other construction equipment efficiently. Perform excavation work around utilities, following safe digging practices. Assist in site preparation and pipe laying activities as needed. Maintain equipment cleanliness and perform basic mechanical checks. Step in with manual labor (e.g., shoveling, grading) to support crew operations. Follow safety protocols, communicate effectively with team members, and maintain a clean and organized work site. Qualifications:

jobs.title: Commercial HVAC Service Technician
jobs.department: Astacio Plumbing, Heating, Cooling, and Electric
jobs.description: Commercial HVAC Service Technician Astacio Plumbing, Heating, Cooling & Electrical | Norwalk, CT Bring Your Commercial HVAC Expertise to a Team That Values Professionalism Commercial customers depend on their heating and cooling systems to keep employees comfortable, operations moving, and buildings functioning properly. They need a technician who can diagnose complex equipment, communicate clearly, and take ownership of every service call. At Astacio Plumbing, Heating, Cooling & Electrical, we’re looking for an experienced Commercial HVAC Service Technician to provide service, repair, and preventive maintenance for a variety of commercial heating and cooling systems. You’ll work independently in the field while receiving support from a knowledgeable office and operations team. This is an opportunity for a skilled technician who values quality workmanship, professional customer relationships, and continued technical growth. If you’re dependable, technically strong, and ready to represent a trusted home and commercial services company, we want to talk to you. What You’ll Do Diagnose, service, repair, and maintain commercial heating and cooling systems. Work on packaged rooftop units, split systems, chillers, heat pumps, boilers, and related commercial equipment. Perform preventive maintenance, inspections, system testing, and operational evaluations. Troubleshoot electrical, mechanical, refrigeration, airflow, hydronic, and control-system issues. Clearly explain findings, recommended repairs, and next steps to customers. Obtain customer authorization before performing additional work. Collect payment on-site when appropriate. Open and close jobs accurately within the electronic scheduling system. Document arrival times, work performed, job completion, follow-up needs, and detailed service summaries. Communicate parts, equipment, scheduling, and return-trip needs promptly to the office. Maintain clean, organized, and professional vehicles and jobsites. Take responsibility for assigned trucks, diagnostic tools, equipment, uniforms, and inventory. Train apprentices in the field and lead by example through safe, professional work practices. Attend required technical training, team meetings, and company meetings. Protect company and customer information and maintain appropriate confidentiality. Build positive working relationships with customers, coworkers, apprentices, and leadership. Receive and implement coaching and feedback professionally. What We’re Looking For Previous commercial HVAC service, maintenance, and repair experience. Experience with packaged rooftop units, split systems, chillers, heat pumps, boilers, and related commercial systems. Strong diagnostic and troubleshooting skills. Knowledge of refrigeration, electrical, airflow, hydronic, combustion, and control systems. Ability to independently manage service calls from diagnosis through completion. Ability to read wiring diagrams, equipment specifications, and technical documentation. Strong communication and customer service skills. Professional appearance and demeanor. Ability to provide clear, complete, and timely service documentation. Willingness and ability to train apprentices and less-experienced technicians. Strong judgment, self-control, and respect for customer and company confidentiality. Ability to accept and apply constructive feedback. lists.content:
Commercial Refrigeration Technician

Sila Services – Stoneham, MA

Know your way around a walk-in freezer, rack system, or ice machine? Can you actually diagnose the problem instead of just throwing parts at it? We should talk.

Sila Services is looking for an experienced Commercial Refrigeration Technician who knows their stuff and takes pride in doing the job right. We’re growing, we stay busy, and we believe great techs deserve a great place to work.

You bring the refrigeration experience — we’ll bring the steady work, great benefits, company vehicle, tools, training, and a team that has your back.

What You’ll Work On

  • Walk-in coolers and freezers
  • Medium and low-temperature refrigeration systems
  • Rack and multiplex refrigeration systems
  • Reach-in coolers and freezers
  • Chillers
  • Ice machines including Hoshizaki, Manitowoc and Scotsman
  • RTUs and split systems tied into refrigeration loads
  • R404A, R448A, R449A, R134a and R410A systems
  • TXV and EEV diagnostics and replacement

    • What You’ll Do

    • Diagnose, service, repair and maintain commercial refrigeration and HVAC/R equipment
    • Troubleshoot electrical, mechanical and refrigeration issues
    • Perform preventative maintenance
    • Complete equipment installations and replacements
    • Provide repair recommendations and quotes when needed
    • Document service calls and customer information
    • Order parts and obtain pricing
    • Communicate with customers about what you found and how you’ll fix it
    • Maintain your company vehicle and equipment
    • Follow company and industry safety standards
    • Participate in an on-call rotation

      • What We’re Looking For

      • 7–10+ years of commercial refrigeration/HVAC-R service experience
      • Strong diagnostic and troubleshooting skills
      • Experience with walk-ins, rack systems, ice machines and commercial refrigeration equipment
      • Strong understanding of refrigeration controls and electrical systems
      • Experience diagnosing and replacing TXVs and EEVs
      • Comfortable working independently in the field
      • Someone who takes ownership, solves problems and takes care of the customer
      • Valid driver’s license

        • Why Sila?

        Because good techs have options — and we want Sila to be the place you choose to stay.

        You’ll have steady work, a company vehicle and gas card, great benefits, a tool account, paid time off, a 401(k) with company match, and opportunities to keep learning and growing.

        If you know refrigeration and want to work somewhere that values good people and great work, come join Sila Services in Stoneham.

         

        #HP1

If you’re an experienced refrigeration tech, you already know your skills are in demand. So why not work somewhere that recognizes what you bring to the table?

Sila Services/NETR is growing, and we’re looking for an experienced Commercial Refrigeration Technician who knows their way around walk-ins, reach-ins, ice machines, rooftop equipment, and commercial refrigeration systems — and knows how to troubleshoot when things get complicated.

We offer steady work, great pay, strong benefits, overtime opportunities, and a team that appreciates experienced techs.

You bring the refrigeration experience. We’ll give you a place to build on it.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll diagnose, service, repair, and maintain commercial refrigeration and HVAC/R equipment for our customers, including:

  • Walk-in coolers and freezers
  • Reach-in refrigerators and freezers
  • Commercial ice machines
  • Remote condensing units
  • Refrigeration racks and supermarket systems
  • Rooftop units
  • Compressors, evaporators, condensers, and expansion valves
  • Electronic controls, thermostats, sensors, and defrost systems

    • You’ll troubleshoot electrical and mechanical issues, perform leak detection and refrigerant recovery/charging, analyze superheat and subcooling, complete preventative maintenance, and make sure equipment is operating the way it should.

    What We’re Looking For

    We’re looking for someone who can get into the field and knows what they’re doing.

    You should have 5+ years of commercial refrigeration/HVAC-R service experience, strong diagnostic skills, and experience working with commercial refrigeration equipment.

    EPA Section 608 certification and a valid driver’s license are required. Trade school or HVAC/R technical training is preferred.

    You should also be comfortable brazing and soldering, reading wiring diagrams and service manuals, and using gauges, meters, vacuum pumps, recovery machines, and other diagnostic tools.

    Most importantly, you can diagnose the problem, figure out the solution, communicate with the customer, and get the equipment back up and running.

    The Good Stuff

    $55–$60/hour with the ability to earn $125K–$135K+ annually

    Plus:

    • Up to $5,000 sign-on bonus
    • Overtime paid at time-and-a-half after 8 hours in a day
    • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
    • Health Spending Account with company contribution
    • 401(k) with employer match
    • Paid time off and paid holidays
    • Tuition reimbursement
    • Company vehicle and gas card
    • Company phone and tablet
    • Company uniforms
    • Tool and boot allowance
    • Parental leave
    • Opportunities to grow and advance

      Come join Sila Services/NETR and see what it’s like to work for a company that works for you, too. Apply today!

raw.salaryDescription:
A to Z - Customer Service

We're currently seeking skilled Customer Service Representatives to join our tight-knit family. at A to Z. As a CSR on our team, you'll have the opportunity to showcase your expertise, tackle exciting projects, and make a real difference in the lives of our customers. From servicing systems to diagnosing and fixing issues and everything in between, you'll be at the forefront of delivering top-notch HVAC services that our customers can rely on.

If you have home services experience and know your way around ServiceTitan, we'd love to meet you!

What You'll Do

  • Answer inbound customer calls for residential HVAC, plumbing, and electrical services
  • Schedule service appointments using ServiceTitan
  • Provide exceptional customer service while resolving customer questions and concerns
  • Communicate clearly and professionally with customers, technicians, and office staff
  • Maintain accurate customer records and detailed job notes
  • Prioritize emergency calls and schedule technicians efficiently
  • Promote maintenance memberships and additional services when appropriate
  • Support the team by helping create an outstanding customer experience from the first call to the completed job

What We're Looking For

  • Previous experience as a Customer Service Representative in a residential HVAC, plumbing, electrical, or home services company
  • Working knowledge of residential HVAC, plumbing, and electrical terminology
  • Experience using ServiceTitan for scheduling, call booking, and customer management
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong customer service and problem-solving abilities
  • Ability to multitask and stay organized in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to remain calm, professional, and empathetic while handling customer concerns
  • Positive attitude and team-first mentality
  • Strong sense of accountability and ownership
  • Dependable attendance and punctuality
  • Sales-minded approach with the ability to identify opportunities for memberships, maintenance agreements, and additional services

What You'll Get

  • $15-$17 per hour based on experience
  • Full-time, year-round position
  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits
  • Paid Time Off and paid holidays
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Ongoing training and career growth opportunities
  • Supportive team environment with opportunities to advance

raw.description:
Customer Service Representative| Stoneham, MA

Tired of being just another tech on the schedule? Come work somewhere that actually values what you bring to the table. 

At Sila Boston, we take care of our people, invest in great tools and training, and give our techs real opportunities to grow and make great money. You’ll have steady work, a strong team behind you, and the resources of a growing company — without losing that local team feel. 

If you’re good at what you do and want to work with good people who appreciate it, come see why Sila Boston is a great place to build your career. 

 

Job Description 

We are looking for a friendly, organized Customer Service Representative who can handle a busy phone, solve problems, and make sure every customer feels taken care of. 

 

Job Duties 

Answer incoming calls and provide a professional, friendly customer experience 

Schedule service appointments and gather accurate customer information 

Listen to customer concerns and ask the right questions to understand their needs 

Handle multiple calls, tasks, and priorities in a fast-paced environment 

Follow up with customers as needed 

Identify opportunities for additional services and maintenance plans 

Enter and maintain accurate customer information in company systems 

Communicate with dispatchers, technicians, and other team members 

Handle customer concerns calmly and professionally 

Assist with administrative tasks and special projects as needed 

 

Skills & Experience 

1+ years of customer service, call center, or home services experience preferred 

Excellent phone presence and communication skills 

Strong organization and attention to detail 

Ability to multitask and prioritize in a busy environment 

Comfortable handling upset or frustrated customers 

Basic computer proficiency and ability to learn new software quickly 

Strong written communication skills 

Dependable, positive, and team-oriented 

HVAC, plumbing, electrical, or Service Titan experience is a plus 

 

What Success Looks Like 

Shows up ready to work and follows through on commitments 

Takes pride in quality work and attention to detail 

Communicates clearly with customers and teammates 

Works safely and follows established processes 

Takes ownership, solves problems, and is willing to keep learning 

 

Benefits 

Medical, dental, and vision insurance 

401(k) with company match 

Paid time off and paid holidays 

Company-paid life and disability insurance 

Paid training and professional development 

Opportunities for career growth and advancement

jobs.title: Customer Service Representative
jobs.description: Customer Service Representative Nashoba Air & BoilerWorks – Littleton, MA $21–$25/hour | Full-Time | On-Site Are you the person who can turn a frustrated customer into a happy one? Do you love talking to people, solving problems, and keeping things organized when the phones are busy? We want to meet you! At Nashoba Air & BoilerWorks, we take care of our customers — and we take care of our people, too. You’ve probably seen our trucks around town, but what you may not know is that we’re a team where hard work is noticed, good people are appreciated, and there’s real opportunity to grow. We’re looking for a friendly, organized Customer Service Representative who can keep up with a busy home services office and make every customer feel taken care of. What You’ll Do Answer incoming calls and provide an awesome customer experience Schedule appointments and help customers get the service they need Listen to customer concerns, ask the right questions, and find solutions Handle multiple calls and priorities without losing the details Follow up with customers as needed Help identify opportunities for additional services Keep accurate customer information and notes in our system Work closely with our dispatchers, technicians, and office team Learn our services so you can confidently answer customer questions Keep things moving when the phones get busy! What We’re Looking For Great phone presence and customer service skills Strong verbal and written communication Someone friendly, positive, and professional Ability to stay calm with an upset or frustrated customer Excellent organization and attention to detail Comfortable multitasking in a busy, fast-paced office Basic computer skills and the ability to learn new systems quickly Dependable, self-motivated, and ready to jump in Home services, HVAC, plumbing, dispatch, or ServiceTitan experience is a plus! Schedule Monday–Friday, 7:30 AM–4:30 PM Occasional Saturday, 9:00 AM–2:00 PM (approximately once every 1–2 months) This position is 100% on-site in Littleton, MA. It is not remote or hybrid. What You’ll Get $21–$25/hour Medical, dental, and vision insurance 401(k) with company match Paid time off Paid training Parental leave Referral program Professional development and opportunities to grow If you’re great with people, can handle a busy phone, and want to work somewhere you’re appreciated — come join Nashoba! #SG&A

jobs.title: Customer Service Representative/Dispatcher
jobs.description: Customer Service Representative/Dispatcher JSP Home Services | Kingston, NY Be the Voice Customers Remember When a customer calls JSP Home Services, the person who answers the phone sets the tone for their entire experience. We’re looking for an experienced Customer Service Representative/Dispatcher who can handle a high volume of calls, listen carefully, solve problems, and turn customer needs into accurately booked appointments. This role is ideal for someone who is calm under pressure, naturally helpful, and confident guiding conversations toward the right next step. At JSP Home Services, great customer service means more than answering the phone. It means making customers feel heard, capturing the right information, coordinating service accurately, and creating a positive experience from the very first interaction. Why Join JSP Home Services? Competitive compensation Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays 401(k) with Company Match Ongoing Training and Professional Development Career Growth Opportunities Year-Round, Stable Employment Supportive, Team-Oriented Work Environment On-Site Position in Kingston, NY The Role As a Customer Service Representative, you’ll serve as the first point of contact for customers calling about plumbing, heating, cooling, electrical, and other home service needs. You’ll answer inbound calls, identify the customer’s needs, accurately schedule appointments, and help ensure each call results in a clear and positive next step. You’ll also support outbound customer communication, including appointment confirmations, follow-up calls, membership renewals, unsold estimate follow-up, and customer satisfaction calls. Key Responsibilities Answer a high volume of inbound customer calls with a friendly, professional phone presence. Listen carefully, ask the right questions, and accurately identify each customer’s service needs. Book, confirm, reschedule, and cancel appointments while capturing complete and accurate customer information. Communicate appointment expectations, service availability, and next steps clearly. De-escalate upset or stressed customers and work toward a positive resolution. Overcome booking objections and help customers understand the value of scheduling service. Promote maintenance plans, memberships, and available service options when appropriate. Make outbound calls for appointment confirmations, customer follow-up, happy calls, membership renewals, and unsold estimates. Maintain accurate customer records and call notes within the company’s scheduling and CRM systems. Coordinate closely with dispatchers, technicians, and other team members to support an efficient customer experience. Meet individual and team expectations for booking rates, call quality, accuracy, and customer satisfaction. Maintain reliable attendance and punctuality for this on-site position. Qualifications At least 2 years of customer service experience in a phone-heavy environment, such as a call center, dispatch office, front office, or service-based business. Strong verbal communication and active listening skills. Comfortable managing high call volume while remaining friendly, focused, and professional. Ability to book and manage appointments accurately while capturing complete customer information. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to remain composed with upset or frustrated customers. Basic computer proficiency and the ability to learn scheduling and CRM software quickly. Reliable attendance and the ability to work on-site in Kingston, NY. Prior experience in home services, plumbing, HVAC, electrical, or another trade-related business is a plus. Experience with ServiceTitan or a comparable field service management platform is preferred. Experience with outbound calling, customer follow-up, membership renewals, or unsold estimate rehash is preferred. Sales-minded and comfortable overcoming objections and promoting memberships or maintenance plans. Bilingual English and Spanish is a plus. What Success Looks Like Success in this role means customers feel heard, appointments are booked accurately, and every conversation moves toward a helpful resolution. You’ll build trust over the phone, support the field team with complete information, and help JSP Home Services deliver a smooth and professional customer experience from the first call through the completed service.

Great dispatchers do more than fill a schedule. They keep technicians productive, customers informed, and the entire service operation moving.
Jones Services is looking for a Dispatcher to join our team in Goshen, NY. This is a fast-paced role where you’ll coordinate our field technicians throughout the day, prioritize incoming service needs, adjust schedules when things change, and help make sure we’re putting the right technician in front of the right customer at the right time.
If you’re highly organized, comfortable making decisions, and can stay calm when the schedule changes unexpectedly, this could be a great opportunity for you.
What You’ll Do
Manage and continuously monitor the daily dispatch board for HVAC, plumbing, and electrical service technicians
Dispatch technicians to service calls based on skill set, location, availability, priority, and customer needs
Maintain an efficient schedule that helps maximize technician productivity and minimizes unnecessary drive time
Monitor technician progress throughout the day and proactively adjust the schedule when jobs run long, cancellations occur, or emergency calls come in

Keep customers informed of technician arrival windows, delays, or changes to their appointments

Review upcoming calls to ensure technicians are appropriately matched to the work being performed
Maintain accurate customer, technician, and appointment information in the scheduling system
Follow up with technicians when additional information, job status updates, or next-step decisions are needed
Help ensure completed calls are properly closed out and technicians are ready for their next assignment
Communicate scheduling challenges, capacity concerns, and service issues to leadership
Partner with field leadership and customer service to help provide an outstanding experience from the initial call through completion of service
Remain flexible and solution-oriented as priorities change throughout the day
What We’re Looking For
Previous dispatching, scheduling, customer service, call center, or service coordination experience preferred
Experience dispatching technicians in HVAC, plumbing, electrical, home services, or another field-service environment is strongly preferred
Strong organizational and time-management skills
Ability to make decisions quickly while balancing multiple priorities
Comfortable managing a high volume of activity in a fast-paced environment
Strong verbal and written communication skills
Confident communicating with both customers and field technicians
Ability to remain calm and professional when schedules change or problems arise
Strong attention to detail and commitment to maintaining accurate information
Ability to anticipate problems instead of waiting for them to happen
Team-oriented mindset with a willingness to communicate and collaborate across departments
Experience with ServiceTitan or another field-service management platform is a plus

You don’t simply wait for someone to tell you what to do next.

Successful Dispatchers take ownership of the board and treat the success of the service day as their responsibility.

lists.content:

  • Operate sewer inspection cameras to diagnose drain and sewer line issues and accurately identify blockages, breaks, and defects.
  • Use hydro jetting equipment to clear grease, sludge, roots, and other obstructions from residential drain systems.

  • Collaborating with customers to educate them on preventive maintenance and proper care of their plumbing systems.

  • Keeping work vehicles clean, organized, and stocked with necessary tools and materials to efficiently handle each job.

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues to customers clearly and professionally.
  • Familiarity with ServiceTitan or similar service management software is a plus.

  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

lists.text: As a Sila Drain Cleaning Technician your responsibilities will include:
lists.content:
• Cleaning drains using provided machinery
  • Using electric snakes, high-velocity water jets, and sewer cameras for inspecting drain lines
  • Fixing frozen lines and steam thaw during the winter months
  • Repairing underground sewers and drains using excavation methods
  • Regularly communicating with Plumbing Coordinator where you are, where you've been, and where you are going
  • Properly selecting invoice tasks, complete all necessary forms, complete invoice summary, and debrief call with Plumbing Coordinator
  • Recommending memberships, repairs, upgrades, and replacements when it is in the best interest of the customer
  • Collecting payment for services rendered at time of service
  • Inputting or updating all customer equipment data into CRM
  • Utilizing all pertinent marketing materials (stickers, tags, handouts, forms, etc.)
  • Ensuring your truck stock is replenished and your truck bin is empty
  • Confirming time sheets on tablet
  • Cleaning vehicle (inside and out)
  • Attending Team meetings
  • Attending company provided training classes
  • Staying up to date on all company sales promotions
  • Conducting a vehicle inspection
  • Inventorying truck stock

raw.salaryDescription:
Who we are

You’re the best and you want to join a team that appreciates you, where you can create your own opportunities.

We keep on growing because we only hire the best, and our customers love us for it. We’ve been at this a long time here in Rocky Mount, VA. You’ve probably seen our trucks and our ads. What you don’t know is what it’s like to be a part of a team like this. How much you feel appreciated when you don’t cut corners. How much we inspire ongoing training and education. How it feels to have customers rave about you and demand that you’re the only technician that works in their home. How much you can earn when you truly are the best. People often come to us looking for a job. They stay with us because they find a fulfilling career, room to grow, and opportunities to excel. 

Why we need you

Because we offer top of the line products and services, we need a top of the line Drain Technician who genuinely cares about the customer and look at this opportunity as not just a job but a career.

The big task

You will diagnose and repair residential drain systems and lead customers to informed and confident buying decisions.

Key sub tasks

• Maintain communication with dispatch, your manager, parts and installation teams.

• Keep your company truck clean, inside and out.

• Keep your truck inventory up to date.

• Properly complete paperwork.

• Maintain a clean and professional appearance.

• Have and maintain a clean driving record.

• Participate in training allowing you to grow and develop as a professional.

• Have or be willing to get the proper certifications. We can help you with this.

Skills and experience

If you can achieve the above and you find it fun and challenging - you have just the right amount.

What we offer

• Our top performers are among the highest paid technicians in Rocky Mount, VA. You’ll have unlimited earning potential.

• Company supplied, take it home at night, new and safe, super-cool company truck. 

• Medical Insurance --We offer health, dental, vision, life insurance, short term and long term disability

• New technology, including iPhone, iPad & access to integrated software 

• State of the art tools, parts and supplies.

• 401k Plan 

• A family. This is last on the list because it’s most important. We care about our team, and expect you to bring that same caring when you join. We do a lot more than just work together. You’ll come to love our company outings, and you’ll build life-long friendships at Davis Heating, Cooling, Plumbing, & Electric.

Learn more about us

If you want to be part of something bigger than just a job – make this career move and find exactly what you’re looking for. You will work in a place where you will be appreciated by your team and customers, and where your work has a direct effect on the success of the company. If this sounds like you, spend a little time learning about Davis Heating, Cooling, Plumbing, & Electric by visiting davisheat.com. When you're ready, please follow the directions to apply for this position.

Equal Opportunity Employer

jobs.description: Drain & Sewer Installer Levine & Sons Love working with your hands? Like seeing the results of your work at the end of the day? Join the team at Levine & Sons! We're looking for a Drain & Sewer Installer who takes pride in quality workmanship and wants to be part of a team that works hard, supports one another, and gets the job done right. This role combines sales expertise, technical knowledge, and project ownership to deliver a seamless experience from initial call to job completion. The Electrical Project Manager ensures customers receive honest recommendations, accurate pricing, and a high-quality installation or service outcome while consistently achieving revenue and performance targets. Reports To General Manager Sales Manager Collaborates with Service Manager Salary: $75,000/yr-$175,000/yr Core Values In Action Likeable – You build rapport quickly with homeowners and create a comfortable, trust-driven sales experience. Ethical – You present honest solutions and pricing, always putting the customer’s needs first. Responsible – You own your numbers, your jobs, and your customer experience from start to finish. Knowledgeable – You maintain strong expertise in electrical systems, code requirements, and product offerings. Reliable – You follow through on commitments, communicate clearly, and ensure jobs are completed as promised.

Sales Manager

Collaborates with Service Manager

  • Likeable – You build rapport quickly with homeowners and create a comfortable, trust-driven sales experience.
  • Ethical – You present honest solutions and pricing, always putting the customer’s needs first.
  • Responsible – You own your numbers, your jobs, and your customer experience from start to finish.

raw.salaryDescription:
What You'll Do

Daily Duties

  • Run scheduled sales appointments and service leads
  • Perform in-home evaluations and identify customer needs
  • Build and present clear, solution-based proposals
  • Sell electrical install and service work (panels, service upgrades, generators, rewires, etc.)
  • Ensure accurate job scoping, pricing, and documentation
  • Handle financing options and assist customers through approval process
  • Maintain consistent follow-up on open estimates
  • Communicate job details clearly with install and service teams
  • Ensure CRM documentation is complete and accurate for all opportunities
  • Manage customer expectations from sale through project completion

Weekly Duties

  • Review personal performance metrics (close rate, average ticket, revenue)
  • Track open estimates and follow-up opportunities
  • Coordinate upcoming jobs with install teams to ensure readiness
  • Review pipeline and forecast upcoming sales
  • Follow up on completed jobs to ensure customer satisfaction

Monthly Duties

  • Review individual KPIs and sales performance
  • Identify areas for improvement in close rate and average ticket
  • Participate in training on products, systems, and sales process
  • Review pricing, financing usage, and overall job profitability

How Success Is Measured

  • Sales Volume: Weekly, monthly, and quarterly revenue targets are consistently met
  • Close Rate: Maintain strong conversion rates on provided leads
  • Average Sale: Jobs are sold with proper scope, pricing, and profitability
  • Customer Experience: Positive customer feedback and strong online reviews
  • Job Accuracy: Sold jobs are installed without major scope gaps or issues

Skills You Need

  • Sales Expertise – You can confidently present and close high-value residential electrical work
  • Electrical Knowledge – You understand residential electrical systems, upgrades, and code requirements
  • Customer Communication – You simplify complex work and guide customers through decisions
  • Time Management – You manage appointments, follow-ups, and active jobs effectively
  • Attention to Detail – You ensure accurate scoping, pricing, and job documentation
  • Collaboration – You work closely with install, service, and warehouse teams to execute jobs successfully

Education & Certifications

  • High school diploma or GED required
  • Previous experience in electrical sales or field experience preferred
  • Knowledge of electrical systems, code requirements, and permitting is a plus
  • Experience with CRM systems, estimating tools, and financing platforms preferred

The right opportunity should offer more than a full schedule—it should provide steady customer demand, strong office support, quality tools, continued training, and a company that respects the expertise you bring into every home. At JSP Home Services, we’re looking for an experienced Residential Service Electrician who takes pride in accurate diagnostics, safe workmanship, and creating a professional customer experience. You’ll have the support of a knowledgeable dispatch and operations team, the resources needed to work efficiently, and opportunities to continue growing your skills and earning potential. As a Residential Service Electrician, you’ll diagnose, repair, and improve residential electrical systems while helping homeowners understand their options and make informed decisions about the safety and reliability of their homes. If you’re looking for year-round work, strong operational support, and a company that values quality, accountability, and doing the job right, JSP Home Services may be the right place for your next move. What You’ll Do Diagnose, troubleshoot, repair, and maintain residential electrical systems. Install and replace panels, breakers, circuits, outlets, switches, lighting, ceiling fans, and other electrical components. Complete service upgrades, wiring repairs, dedicated circuits, and electrical system improvements. Install EV chargers, generators, surge protection, smoke detectors, and other residential electrical equipment. Perform electrical safety inspections and identify code, safety, or performance concerns. Clearly explain findings and recommend appropriate repair or replacement options. Obtain customer approval before completing work and collect payment when appropriate. Complete accurate estimates, service notes, photos, and follow-up documentation. Protect customers’ homes and maintain a clean, professional work area. Maintain assigned vehicles, tools, materials, and truck inventory. Coordinate with dispatch, customer service, and other field teams. Participate in required meetings, technical training, and professional development. What We’re Looking For Previous residential electrical service and repair experience. Strong diagnostic and troubleshooting abilities. Knowledge of residential wiring methods, electrical systems, and the National Electrical Code. Ability to independently manage service calls from diagnosis through completion. Strong communication and customer service skills. Ability to explain technical findings and available options clearly to homeowners. Comfortable presenting service options and making appropriate recommendations. Commitment to safe, code-compliant, and high-quality work. New York electrical license or applicable local credentials preferred. Comfortable using tablets, mobile applications, and field service software. As a portfolio company of Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Sila combines the entrepreneurial environment of locally operated home-services businesses with the resources and growth ambitions of a scaled national platform.

For the General Manager at Guy Smith, that means the opportunity to lead a local business with real ownership while having access to broader resources, experienced leaders, best practices, and career opportunities across a growing organization.

What You’ll Own

  • Full P&L responsibility, including revenue, gross margin, labor, operating expenses, and profitability.
  • Overall leadership of field operations, customer service, sales, and office support.
  • Building the people, processes, and operating structure needed to support continued growth.
  • Developing and executing plans to achieve aggressive but realistic revenue and profitability goals.
  • Hiring, coaching, developing, and retaining a strong leadership team.
  • Creating clear expectations and accountability as the organization grows.
  • Reviewing financial and operational results, identifying issues early, and taking action.
  • Improving processes to create greater consistency, efficiency, and scalability.
  • Leading organizational change and ensuring new processes and expectations are successfully adopted.
  • Maintaining an exceptional customer experience as volume and headcount increase.
  • Managing budgets, forecasts, staffing, and capacity based on current and future business needs.
  • Identifying opportunities to expand revenue, improve profitability, and strengthen market performance.

Lead and Develop the Team

  • Build and develop a leadership team capable of running a growing operation of 60+ team members.
  • Set clear expectations and provide direct, timely feedback.
  • Hold leaders and team members accountable while maintaining trust and respect.
  • Identify and develop high-potential employees who can take on greater responsibility.
  • Create an environment where employees understand where the business is going and how they contribute.
  • Address performance issues early rather than allowing problems to become embedded.
  • Lead teams through change with clarity, consistency, and follow-through.
  • Build a culture where strong performance, customer service, and continuous improvement are expected.

Own the Financial & Operational Performance

  • Own annual budgets, forecasts, and operating plans.
  • Understand the financial statements and the operational decisions behind them.
  • Monitor revenue, gross margin, labor efficiency, productivity, customer metrics, and other key performance indicators.
  • Identify the root causes behind missed targets and implement corrective actions.
  • Use data to make decisions rather than simply report results.
  • Build repeatable processes and operating rhythms that can support continued growth.
  • Anticipate staffing, leadership, capacity, and process needs before they become constraints.
  • Balance immediate performance with the investments required for sustainable growth.

Own the Customer Experience

The General Manager is ultimately accountable for how Guy Smith Home Services shows up for its customers.

Growth cannot come at the expense of service.

You’ll ensure teams continue delivering a professional, responsive, and consistent customer experience as the business grows. When something goes wrong, the expectation is to solve the immediate problem, understand why it happened, and improve the process so the organization becomes stronger as a result.

What We’re Looking For

  • Proven experience leading a business, branch, location, or significant operating team with revenue in excess of at least $15M - $30M annually.

  • Strong people leadership and team-development skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to improve and scale processes.
  • Experience successfully leading teams through meaningful change.
  • Strong financial and business acumen.
  • Ability to use data and operating metrics to make decisions.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to create alignment across teams.
  • Customer-focused mindset with high standards for service and execution.
  • Comfortable making difficult decisions and holding people accountable.
  • High level of ownership, urgency, judgment, and follow-through.

What Success Looks Like

Success means Guy Smith Home Services grows and becomes a better-run business at the same time.

Revenue and profitability increase. Processes become more consistent. Leaders become more capable. The organization develops the capacity to handle greater volume without sacrificing customer service or employee experience.

You won’t be expected to have every answer on day one. What matters is having the judgment to recognize when something isn’t working, understand why, adjust quickly, and make the organization stronger as a result.

Ultimately, the business should be better positioned for its next stage of growth because of the people, processes, discipline, and culture you put in place.

Ready to Lead the Next Stage of Growth?

If you’re a people-focused business leader with strong financial discipline, a track record of improving operations, and the ability to lead an organization through growth and change, we want to talk to you.

Apply today to lead Guy Smith Home Services in Norfolk, VA.

jobs.description: HVAC Apprentice Location: Pittsburgh, PA Launch Your HVAC Career with Sullivan Super Service! Ready to learn a trade that's always in demand? At Sullivan Super Service, we're looking for motivated, hardworking individuals who want to build a long-term career in residential HVAC. If you're mechanically inclined, eager to learn, and enjoy working with your hands, we'll provide the training, mentorship, and opportunities to help you grow into a skilled HVAC Technician. Positive attitude with a strong work ethic. Dependable, punctual, and coachable. Excellent customer service and communication skills. Ability to lift 50+ pounds and work in attics, crawl spaces, and outdoor conditions. Valid driver's license with a clean driving record. EPA Certification is a plus but not required. Why Join Sullivan Super Service? Competitive hourly pay Overtime opportunities Medical, dental, and vision insurance 401(k) with company match Paid time off and paid holidays Company-provided training and ongoing development Career advancement opportunities Supportive team environment Stable, year-round work If you're ready to start a rewarding career in the HVAC industry with a company that invests in your future, apply today and join the Sullivan Super Service team!

jobs.title: HVAC Install Apprentice
jobs.description: HVAC Install Apprentice Guy Smith Home Services | Norfolk, VA Learn the Trade from Experienced Installers—and Build a Career That Lasts Starting a career in HVAC takes more than getting hired as a helper. You need hands-on training, experienced people willing to teach you, steady opportunities to practice your skills, and a company that gives you a clear path forward. At Guy Smith Home Services, our HVAC Install Apprentices work alongside skilled Lead Installers while learning how residential heating and cooling systems are installed safely and correctly. You’ll receive paid, on-the-job training, work with professional tools and equipment, and build practical experience on real residential installations. This is an opportunity to learn a valuable trade with a company that wants to see you advance. As your skills, knowledge, and independence grow, you’ll have opportunities to take on more responsibility and progress toward becoming an HVAC Installer and, eventually, a Lead Installer. If you’re mechanically inclined, dependable, and ready to learn from experienced professionals, Guy Smith Home Services can help you turn your work ethic into a rewarding skilled-trade career. What You’ll Do Assist Lead HVAC Installers with residential replacement and installation projects. Help remove old equipment and prepare jobsites for new systems. Stage, load, unload, and organize equipment, materials, tools, and supplies. Assist with installing furnaces, air conditioners, heat pumps, air handlers, mini-splits, thermostats, and indoor air quality equipment. Support ductwork modifications, refrigerant piping, drainage, venting, gas piping, wiring, and other system connections under supervision. Learn proper equipment startup, testing, charging, airflow verification, and commissioning procedures. Follow installation plans, manufacturer instructions, safety requirements, and company standards. Protect customers’ homes and maintain clean, organized, and safe jobsites. Complete assigned job documentation and required photos using company software. Maintain tools, equipment, materials, and vehicle inventory. Communicate professionally with customers, Lead Installers, and office team members. Participate in required technical, safety, product, and customer service training. What We’re Looking For A strong interest in building a long-term HVAC career. Mechanical aptitude and comfort working with tools. Dependable attendance, punctuality, and a strong work ethic. Willingness to learn, accept coaching, and follow instructions. Ability to work effectively as part of an installation team. Professional attitude and respect for customers and their homes. HVAC, construction, maintenance, electrical, or mechanical experience is a plus but not required. Trade school or HVAC coursework is a plus. EPA certification is preferred but not required at the time of hire. Comfortable learning tablets, mobile applications, and field service software. Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record. Ability to lift equipment and work in attics, basements, crawl spaces, mechanical rooms, and outdoor conditions. Why Work at Guy Smith Home Services? Paid, hands-on training with experienced HVAC installers Steady, year-round installation demand Clear advancement path toward HVAC Installer and Lead Installer roles Strong office, warehouse, and operational support Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance 401(k) with Company Match Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays Uniforms Provided Ongoing Paid Technical and Safety Training Access to professional tools, equipment, and installation resources Career Advancement Opportunities A professional environment that values quality, accountability, and teamwork What Success Looks Like Success in this role means showing up prepared, supporting your installation team, and steadily building the skills needed to complete quality HVAC work. You’ll learn from experienced professionals, contribute to safe and professional jobsites, and take meaningful steps toward becoming a skilled HVAC Installer with Guy Smith Home Services.

lists.text: Residential HVAC Install Apprentice Success Metrics:
lists.content:
• Customer Satisfaction: Maintain customer satisfaction rate through post-service surveys and feedback. Strive to exceed customer expectations and resolve any concerns promptly.
  • Installation Quality: Maintain a consistently high level of installation quality, as evaluated through post-installation inspections and customer feedback.
  • Efficiency and Productivity: Complete HVAC installations within the established timeframes, meeting or exceeding the company's productivity standards.
  • First-Time Installation Success: Achieve a first-time installation success rate as established by the Installation Manager, ensuring minimal revisits or callbacks due to installation-related issues.
  • Technical Proficiency: Continuously update and enhance technical skills, staying informed about the latest installation techniques, manufacturer guidelines, and industry best practices.
  • Safety Adherence: Maintain a perfect safety record, strictly adhering to all safety protocols and guidelines. Ensure zero safety incidents or accidents within the performance period.
  • Professionalism, Appearance, and Customer Communication: Demonstrate excellent communication skills when interacting with customers during installations. Uphold a professional appearance and demeanor while representing Jackson Comfort during installations, earning high marks for professionalism from customers.
  • Accuracy of Documentation: Maintain accurate and complete documentation of installation details, equipment used, and any modifications in the company's systems, such as Service Titan.
  • Team Collaboration: Work collaboratively with the Install Apprentice and other team members, fostering a positive and supportive work environment that promotes teamwork.
  • Continual Improvement: Actively participate in performance reviews and self-assessments, identifying areas for personal improvement and setting development goals to enhance overall job performance. Pursue additional certifications and training opportunities to expand expertise and proficiency in installing various brands of HVAC equipment.
  • Timeliness and Punctuality: Maintain a consistent record of punctuality and attendance, arriving at installation sites and appointments on time.
  • Additional duties as assigned

lists.content:
• Installing HVAC related equipment according to manufacturer’s specifications.
  • Designing, fabricating and installing various ducts and duct fittings as required.
  • Receiving, verifying, and loading all equipment and materials needed for each job.
  • Demonstrating and establishing effective working relationships with co-workers, superiors.
  • Properly completing all paperwork required for each job.
  • Maintaining cleanliness of assigned company vehicle.
  • Maintaining high levels of customer service and satisfaction.

• Customer Satisfaction: Maintain customer satisfaction rate through post-service surveys and feedback. Strive to exceed customer expectations and resolve any concerns promptly.
  • Installation Quality: Maintain a consistently high level of installation quality, as evaluated through post-installation inspections and customer feedback.
  • Efficiency and Productivity: Complete HVAC installations within the established timeframes, meeting or exceeding the company's productivity standards.
  • First-Time Installation Success: Achieve a first-time installation success rate as established by the Installation Manager, ensuring minimal revisits or callbacks due to installation-related issues.
  • Technical Proficiency: Continuously update and enhance technical skills, staying informed about the latest installation techniques, manufacturer guidelines, and industry best practices.
  • Safety Adherence: Maintain a perfect safety record, strictly adhering to all safety protocols and guidelines. Ensure zero safety incidents or accidents within the performance period.
  • Mentorship and Guidance: Provide effective mentorship and guidance to the Install Apprentice, contributing to their skill development and ensuring a positive learning experience.
  • Professionalism, Appearance, and Customer Communication: Demonstrate excellent communication skills when interacting with customers during installations. Uphold a professional appearance and demeanor while representing Nashoba Air & BoilerWorks during installations, earning high marks for professionalism from customers.
  • Accuracy of Documentation: Maintain accurate and complete documentation of installation details, equipment used, and any modifications in the company's systems, such as Service Titan.
  • Team Collaboration: Work collaboratively with the Install Apprentice and other team members, fostering a positive and supportive work environment that promotes teamwork.
  • Continual Improvement: Actively participate in performance reviews and self-assessments, identifying areas for personal improvement and setting development goals to enhance overall job performance. Pursue additional certifications and training opportunities to expand expertise and proficiency in installing various brands of HVAC equipment.
  • Installer and Apprentice Development: Monitor and track the progress of the Install Apprentice, providing regular feedback and opportunities for growth and skill advancement.
  • Timeliness and Punctuality: Maintain a consistent record of punctuality and attendance, arriving at installation sites and appointments on time.
  • Additional duties as assigned

jobs.description: HVAC Installer JSP Home Services | Kingston, NY Experienced HVAC installers know that a successful job depends on more than technical skill. It takes accurate job information, the right materials, strong coordination, and a company that gives its field teams the support needed to complete installations correctly. At JSP Home Services, we’re looking for an experienced HVAC Installer who takes pride in clean workmanship, professional service, and doing the job right the first time. You’ll have steady installation demand, strong office and warehouse support, and the tools and resources needed to deliver quality work without unnecessary delays or shortcuts. If you’re dependable, mechanically skilled, and looking for a company that values your craftsmanship and gives you room to grow, JSP Home Services may be the right place for your next move. Remove existing equipment and prepare jobsites for replacement systems. Identify and communicate material, equipment, or scope concerns promptly. Follow manufacturer requirements, applicable codes, safety procedures, and company installation standards. Protect customers’ homes and maintain clean, organized, and professional jobsites. Explain basic system operation and maintenance expectations to homeowners. Complete accurate job notes, equipment records, photos, and required documentation. Maintain assigned vehicles, tools, equipment, materials, and inventory. Participate in technical, safety, product, and customer service training. What We’re Looking For Previous residential HVAC installation experience. Knowledge of furnaces, boilers, air conditioners, heat pumps, mini-splits, ductwork, refrigeration, airflow, venting, and related components. Strong mechanical aptitude and jobsite problem-solving skills. Ability to complete assigned installation work safely and efficiently. Commitment to quality workmanship, safety, and code compliance. Strong communication and teamwork skills. Professional appearance and respect for customers and their homes. EPA certification required. Comfortable using tablets, mobile applications, and field service software. Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record. Ability to lift equipment and work in attics, basements, crawl spaces, mechanical rooms, and outdoor conditions. Why Work at JSP Home Services? Competitive compensation based on experience Performance-based earning opportunities Steady, year-round installation demand Strong office, warehouse, and operational support Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance 401(k) with Company Match Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays Company-Provided Vehicle Company Phone or Tablet Uniforms Provided Ongoing Paid Technical and Safety Training Career Advancement Opportunities Support from an experienced HVAC, plumbing, and electrical team A professional environment that values quality, accountability, and teamwork What Success Looks Like Success in this role means completing clean, dependable installations, ensuring systems operate correctly, and treating every customer’s home with care. You’ll communicate clearly, support your installation team, and help JSP Home Services continue earning customer trust through quality workmanship and professional service.

lists.text: Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for Residential HVAC Installer:
lists.content:
• Customer Satisfaction: Maintain customer satisfaction rate through post-service surveys and feedback. Strive to exceed customer expectations and resolve any concerns promptly.
  • Installation Quality: Maintain a consistently high level of installation quality, as evaluated through post-installation inspections and customer feedback.
  • Efficiency and Productivity: Complete HVAC installations within the established timeframes, meeting or exceeding the company's productivity standards.
  • First-Time Installation Success: Achieve a first-time installation success rate as established by the Installation Manager, ensuring minimal revisits or callbacks due to installation-related issues.
  • Technical Proficiency: Continuously update and enhance technical skills, staying informed about the latest installation techniques, manufacturer guidelines, and industry best practices.
  • Safety Adherence: Maintain a perfect safety record, strictly adhering to all safety protocols and guidelines. Ensure zero safety incidents or accidents within the performance period.
  • Mentorship and Guidance: Provide effective mentorship and guidance to the Install Apprentice, contributing to their skill development and ensuring a positive learning experience.
  • Professionalism, Appearance, and Customer Communication: Demonstrate excellent communication skills when interacting with customers during installations. Uphold a professional appearance and demeanor while representing ECS during installations, earning high marks for professionalism from customers.
  • Accuracy of Documentation: Maintain accurate and complete documentation of installation details, equipment used, and any modifications in the company's systems, such as Service Titan.
  • Team Collaboration: Work collaboratively with the Install Apprentice and other team members, fostering a positive and supportive work environment that promotes teamwork.
  • Continual Improvement: Actively participate in performance reviews and self-assessments, identifying areas for personal improvement and setting development goals to enhance overall job performance. Pursue additional certifications and training opportunities to expand expertise and proficiency in installing various brands of HVAC equipment.
  • Installer and Apprentice Development: Monitor and track the progress of the Install Apprentice, providing regular feedback and opportunities for growth and skill advancement.
  • Timeliness and Punctuality: Maintain a consistent record of punctuality and attendance, arriving at installation sites and appointments on time.
  • Additional duties as assigned

raw.salaryDescription:
We're currently seeking skilled HVAC Installers to join our tight-knit family. at A to Z. As an Installer on our team, you'll have the opportunity to showcase your expertise, tackle exciting projects, and make a real difference in the lives of our customers. From installing HVAC systems to everything in between, you'll be at the forefront of delivering top-notch HVAC services that our customers can rely on.
 
Pay: $30.00 - $45.00 per hour
 
As an Installer at A to Z, you will play a pivotal role in our mission to provide unparalleled solutions that prioritize the well-being and satisfaction of our customers. Your technical expertise, dedication to excellence, and customer-centric approach will contribute to our commitment to delivering exceptional residential install services.
 
We don't just offer jobs—we build careers. Here’s why you’ll love being part of our team:
 
Industry-Leading Compensation: We believe in rewarding excellence.
Fully Stocked Warehouse & Parts Runners: We ensure you have the tools and support you need to excel, with a fully stocked warehouse and parts runners at your service.
New Clean Fully Stocked Truck: Drive in style with a new, clean, fully stocked truck that’s ready for any job.
Comprehensive Health Benefits: We offer affordable, high-quality health, dental, and vision insurance to keep you and your family covered.
Paid Time Off Starting Day 1! We believe in the importance of rest and relaxation, so you start earning paid time off from your first day.
401(k) Plan with Company Match: Secure your future with our competitive 401(k) plan, including a generous company match.
Parental Leave: We support our team members through all stages of life, including offering parental leave for new parents.
Tool and Boot Allowance: We provide a tool and boot allowance so you have the best tools to get the job done.
Training and Development Opportunities: We’re committed to your professional growth with training through our Service Professionals Academy and Resource Center!
Yearly Performance Reviews: We believe in continuous improvement and offer yearly performance reviews to ensure you’re on track and rewarded for your hard work.
 
Essential Responsibilities
 
·         Install HVAC related equipment according to manufacturer’s specifications.
·         Designs, fabricates and installs various ducts and duct fittings as required.
·         Receives, verifies, and loads all equipment and materials needed for each job.
·         Demonstrates and establishes effective working relationships with co-workers, superiors.
·         Properly completes all paperwork required for each job.
·         Maintains cleanliness of assigned company vehicle.
·         Maintains high levels of customer service and satisfaction.
·         Mentors an apprentice in order to aid in the growth of their skillset
 
General Responsibilities
 
·         Performs all tasks and duties in an efficient and safe manner.
·         Performs other related duties as assigned or as necessary. Remains flexible and adaptable in work schedules and work assignments as defined by departmental and organizational needs.
·         Represents Sila in a manner that conveys professionalism, confidentiality, courtesy, fairness, personal integrity, and respect for others.
·         Physical requirements include the ability to lift up to 70 lbs, stand, bend, stoop, reach and travel to locations.
 
Qualifications
 
·         3 or more years’ of HVAC installation experience.
·         High School Diploma or equivalent.
·         Ability to be flexible in work schedule.
·         Valid, clean driver’s License.
·         Must have the ability to multi-task.
·         Must have excellent customer service skills.
·         Must possess knowledge of HVAC systems
·         Must have own hand and power tools
 
Skills and Abilities
 
Must have knowledge of safety rules and requirements.
Must have strong attention to detail.
Must have the ability to work independently and as a part of a team.
Job Type: Full-time
 
Pay: $30.00 - $45.00 per hour
 
Benefits:
 
401(k)
401(k) matching
Dental insurance
Employee assistance program
Employee discount
Health insurance
Health savings account
Life insurance
Paid time off
Parental leave
Professional development assistance
Referral program
Tuition reimbursement

8 hour shift
Monday to Friday
Overtime
Weekends as needed

Signing bonus

Lead HVAC Install: 3 years (Required)

EPA Certification (Preferred)

lists.text: Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for Residential HVAC Installer:
lists.content:
• Customer Satisfaction: Maintain customer satisfaction rate through post-service surveys and feedback. Strive to exceed customer expectations and resolve any concerns promptly.
  • Installation Quality: Maintain a consistently high level of installation quality, as evaluated through post-installation inspections and customer feedback.
  • Efficiency and Productivity: Complete HVAC installations within the established timeframes, meeting or exceeding the company's productivity standards.
  • First-Time Installation Success: Achieve a first-time installation success rate as established by the Installation Manager, ensuring minimal revisits or callbacks due to installation-related issues.
  • Technical Proficiency: Continuously update and enhance technical skills, staying informed about the latest installation techniques, manufacturer guidelines, and industry best practices.
  • Safety Adherence: Maintain a perfect safety record, strictly adhering to all safety protocols and guidelines. Ensure zero safety incidents or accidents within the performance period.
  • Mentorship and Guidance: Provide effective mentorship and guidance to the Install Apprentice, contributing to their skill development and ensuring a positive learning experience.
  • Professionalism, Appearance, and Customer Communication: Demonstrate excellent communication skills when interacting with customers during installations. Uphold a professional appearance and demeanor while representing Sila during installations, earning high marks for professionalism from customers.
  • Accuracy of Documentation: Maintain accurate and complete documentation of installation details, equipment used, and any modifications in the company's systems, such as Service Titan.
  • Team Collaboration: Work collaboratively with the Install Apprentice and other team members, fostering a positive and supportive work environment that promotes teamwork.
  • Continual Improvement: Actively participate in performance reviews and self-assessments, identifying areas for personal improvement and setting development goals to enhance overall job performance. Pursue additional certifications and training opportunities to expand expertise and proficiency in installing various brands of HVAC equipment.
  • Installer and Apprentice Development: Monitor and track the progress of the Install Apprentice, providing regular feedback and opportunities for growth and skill advancement.
  • Timeliness and Punctuality: Maintain a consistent record of punctuality and attendance, arriving at installation sites and appointments on time.
  • Additional duties as assigned

lists.content:
• Customer Satisfaction: Maintain customer satisfaction rate through post-service surveys and feedback. Strive to exceed customer expectations and resolve any concerns promptly.
  • Installation Quality: Maintain a consistently high level of installation quality, as evaluated through post-installation inspections and customer feedback.
  • Efficiency and Productivity: Complete HVAC installations within the established timeframes, meeting or exceeding the company's productivity standards.
  • First-Time Installation Success: Achieve a first-time installation success rate as established by the Installation Manager, ensuring minimal revisits or callbacks due to installation-related issues.
  • Technical Proficiency: Continuously update and enhance technical skills, staying informed about the latest installation techniques, manufacturer guidelines, and industry best practices.
  • Safety Adherence: Maintain a perfect safety record, strictly adhering to all safety protocols and guidelines. Ensure zero safety incidents or accidents within the performance period.
  • Mentorship and Guidance: Provide effective mentorship and guidance to the Install Apprentice, contributing to their skill development and ensuring a positive learning experience.
  • Professionalism, Appearance, and Customer Communication: Demonstrate excellent communication skills when interacting with customers during installations. Uphold a professional appearance and demeanor while representing Tristate during installations, earning high marks for professionalism from customers.
  • Accuracy of Documentation: Maintain accurate and complete documentation of installation details, equipment used, and any modifications in the company's systems, such as Service Titan.
  • Team Collaboration: Work collaboratively with the Install Apprentice and other team members, fostering a positive and supportive work environment that promotes teamwork.
  • Continual Improvement: Actively participate in performance reviews and self-assessments, identifying areas for personal improvement and setting development goals to enhance overall job performance. Pursue additional certifications and training opportunities to expand expertise and proficiency in installing various brands of HVAC equipment.
  • Installer and Apprentice Development: Monitor and track the progress of the Install Apprentice, providing regular feedback and opportunities for growth and skill advancement.
  • Timeliness and Punctuality: Maintain a consistent record of punctuality and attendance, arriving at installation sites and appointments on time.
  • Additional duties as assigned

jobs.description: HVAC Sales / Comfort Advisor – N.E.T.R. Love HVAC but really love closing the deal? This might be your next move. N.E.T.R. is growing, and we’re looking for an experienced HVAC Sales/Comfort Advisor who knows how to walk into a home, connect with the homeowner, figure out what they really need, and turn that conversation into a sale. You won’t be sitting around waiting for the phone to ring. We have an established brand, a strong customer base, and leads coming in. We need someone who knows what to do with them. What You’ll Do Run residential HVAC sales leads Meet with homeowners and evaluate their comfort needs Sell furnaces, boilers, heat pumps, central AC, mini splits and complete HVAC systems Present good/better/best options that fit the customer's needs and budget Explain financing, efficiency and equipment options Build trust and confidently ask for the sale Follow up on open proposals and opportunities Maintain a strong close rate and average ticket Keep your pipeline and customer information updated Work closely with our install and operations teams to make sure the customer has a great experience after the sale Who We Want We’re looking for someone with HVAC or home services sales experience who understands the equipment AND knows how to sell it. You’re comfortable sitting at the kitchen table with a homeowner, asking the right questions, overcoming objections and closing high-ticket sales. You’re competitive without being pushy, organized with your follow-up, and motivated by results. Experience selling full HVAC systems is strongly preferred. Why N.E.T.R.? Because if you’re good at HVAC sales, you should have the opportunity to make great money doing it. You’ll have an established company behind you, a team to support what you sell, opportunities to grow, and a compensation plan that rewards performance. If you know HVAC, love sales, and get a little excited when you hear “big ticket” — let’s talk.

Love HVAC but really love closing the deal? This might be your next move.

N.E.T.R. is growing, and we’re looking for an experienced HVAC Sales/Comfort Advisor who knows how to walk into a home, connect with the homeowner, figure out what they really need, and turn that conversation into a sale.

You won’t be sitting around waiting for the phone to ring. We have an established brand, a strong customer base, and leads coming in. We need someone who knows what to do with them.

What You’ll Do

  • Run residential HVAC sales leads
  • Meet with homeowners and evaluate their comfort needs
  • Sell furnaces, boilers, heat pumps, central AC, mini splits and complete HVAC systems
  • Present good/better/best options that fit the customer's needs and budget
  • Explain financing, efficiency and equipment options
  • Build trust and confidently ask for the sale
  • Follow up on open proposals and opportunities
  • Maintain a strong close rate and average ticket
  • Keep your pipeline and customer information updated
  • Work closely with our install and operations teams to make sure the customer has a great experience after the sale

Who We Want

We’re looking for someone with HVAC or home services sales experience who understands the equipment AND knows how to sell it.

You’re comfortable sitting at the kitchen table with a homeowner, asking the right questions, overcoming objections and closing high-ticket sales.

You’re competitive without being pushy, organized with your follow-up, and motivated by results.

Experience selling full HVAC systems is strongly preferred.

Why N.E.T.R.?

Because if you’re good at HVAC sales, you should have the opportunity to make great money doing it.

You’ll have an established company behind you, a team to support what you sell, opportunities to grow, and a compensation plan that rewards performance.

If you know HVAC, love sales, and get a little excited when you hear “big ticket” — let’s talk.

jobs.title: HVAC Outside Sales Representative
jobs.description: Outside Sales Representative / HVAC Comfort Advisor Absolute Air Services | Portland, CT Homeowners do not always know which heating and cooling system is right for their home. They need an experienced professional who can listen, understand their concerns, explain their options clearly, and help them make a confident decision. At Absolute Air Services, we’re looking for a motivated Outside Sales Representative / HVAC Comfort Advisor to meet with homeowners and recommend heating, cooling, and indoor air quality solutions tailored to their comfort needs, home, and budget. You’ll work with qualified, company-generated opportunities and receive the training, resources, and operational support needed to succeed. This is an opportunity for a driven sales professional to build trust with customers, deliver an outstanding in-home experience, and earn based on performance without relying on high-pressure sales tactics. If you’re competitive, customer-focused, and ready to take ownership of your results, Absolute Air Services offers the opportunity to build a rewarding career with a growing home services company. What You’ll Do Meet with homeowners to assess their heating, cooling, and indoor air quality needs. Perform in-home evaluations and recommend appropriate HVAC replacement and upgrade options. Present equipment choices, financing options, warranties, maintenance plans, and available promotions. Prepare accurate estimates and proposals using company sales software. Educate customers on system efficiency, comfort, operating costs, and available solutions. Follow up consistently with customers throughout the decision-making process. Maintain accurate sales activity, customer notes, and opportunity updates within the CRM. Coordinate with installation, service, dispatch, and office teams to ensure a smooth customer experience. Maintain current knowledge of products, pricing, financing programs, and industry trends. Achieve individual sales and revenue goals while maintaining strong customer satisfaction. What We’re Looking For Previous in-home sales, HVAC sales, home improvement sales, or outside sales experience preferred. Strong consultative selling, presentation, and relationship-building skills. A customer-first approach with the ability to recommend solutions without using high-pressure tactics. Self-motivation, competitiveness, and a strong desire to achieve performance goals. Ability to overcome objections and confidently ask for the sale. Excellent verbal communication, listening, and follow-up skills. Strong organization and time-management abilities. Comfortable using tablets, CRM platforms, and sales software. Ability to work a flexible schedule based on customer appointment availability. Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record. Ability to commute to the Portland, CT location and travel throughout the assigned service area. Compensation and Benefits Competitive performance-based compensation with uncapped earning potential. Qualified company-generated sales opportunities. Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance 401(k) with Company Match Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays Company Vehicle or Vehicle Allowance, as applicable Company Phone and Tablet Comprehensive Paid Sales and Product Training Ongoing Coaching and Professional Development Year-Round Sales Opportunities Career Advancement Opportunities Supportive Operations and Installation Teams What Success Looks Like Success in this role means earning homeowners’ trust, understanding what matters most to them, and recommending solutions that improve their comfort and fit their budget. You’ll maintain a disciplined follow-up process, deliver an exceptional sales experience, and consistently achieve strong results while representing Absolute Air Services with honesty and professionalism.
