As an Outside Sales Representative / Comfort Advisor, you'll meet with homeowners to assess their comfort needs, educate them on available solutions, and recommend HVAC systems that best fit their home and budget. We're looking for a motivated, customer-focused sales professional who enjoys building relationships, solving problems, and helping customers make informed decisions.
Why Join Triangle?
Uncapped commissions 
8 weeks of paid training via commission draw
High-quality company-provided leads
Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
401(k) with Company Match
Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays
Company Vehicle or Vehicle Allowance (where applicable)
Company Phone and Tablet
Ongoing Sales and Product Training
Career Growth Opportunities
Year-Round Stability
Family-Oriented Culture
The Role
As an Outside Sales Representative / Comfort Advisor, you'll meet with homeowners following technician referrals, inbound inquiries, and company-generated leads to evaluate their home's comfort needs and recommend HVAC replacement solutions. You'll educate customers on equipment options, financing, warranties, energy efficiency, and available promotions while delivering a professional, pressure-free sales experience.
Key Responsibilities
Meet with homeowners to evaluate heating, cooling, and indoor comfort needs.
Perform in-home assessments and recommend HVAC replacement solutions tailored to each customer's home and budget.
Present system options, financing programs, warranties, maintenance agreements, and available promotions.
Build trust through honest recommendations and exceptional customer service.
Prepare accurate estimates and proposals using company software.
Follow up with customers throughout the sales process to ensure an outstanding experience.
Collaborate with installation teams to ensure a smooth transition from sale to installation.
Maintain accurate customer records and sales activity within the CRM.
Consistently achieve individual sales goals while maintaining high customer satisfaction.
Stay current on product knowledge, manufacturer offerings, industry trends, and company promotions.
Qualifications
Previous in-home sales, HVAC sales, home improvement sales, or outside sales experience preferred.
Strong consultative selling and relationship-building skills.
Excellent communication and presentation abilities.
Self-motivated with a competitive drive and goal-oriented mindset.
Ability to explain technical information in a way homeowners can easily understand.
Strong organizational, time management, and follow-up skills.
Comfortable using tablets, CRM systems, and sales software.
Valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record.
What Success Looks Like
Success in this role means helping homeowners make informed decisions, consistently delivering an outstanding customer experience, and building lasting customer relationships while achieving individual and team sales goals. At Triangle, we believe the best sales professionals are trusted advisors who educate first, recommend honestly, and always put the customer first.

categories.department: AA Service Company Heating and Cooling

raw.salaryDescription:
Pay: $120,000.00 - $280,000.00 per year

Job description:

AA Service Company - Northbrook, IL

Sales Manager

At AA Service Co, we recognize and appreciate the craftsmanship and passion that our team bring to their work. We are dedicated to fostering a supportive and rewarding environment where your skills are not only acknowledged but celebrated. Here, your contributions matter, and your growth is our priority. As a leader in the HVAC industry, we pride ourselves on delivering unmatched comfort and reliability to our customers, reflecting the high standards and dedication of our team.

As a premier residential service company, we are seeking a highly motivated and results-driven Sales Manager to lead, develop, and grow our in-home sales team. In this role, you will:

  • Recruit, train, and mentor comfort advisors and outside sales representatives
  • Drive revenue growth through coaching, ride-alongs, and performance management
  • Develop and execute strategic sales initiatives to expand market share
  • Monitor KPIs, sales metrics, and close rates to ensure team success
  • Uphold a customer-first approach that ensures homeowners receive tailored solutions and an outstanding experience

This is a leadership position for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, performance-based environment and knows how to build a culture of accountability, motivation, and high achievement.

If you’re looking for stability, advancement opportunities, and a compensation plan that rewards strong leadership and sales performance, we invite you to join Jones Services and experience what it’s like to work for a company that works just as hard for you.

Sales Manager Duties and Responsibilities

  • Overseeing sales, promotions, and campaigns
  • Ability to design and implement successful sales strategies and motivate, influence, and impact a team of Sales Reps.
  • Planning and directing the hiring and training of new Sales Representatives
  • Directing and coordinating all sales activities.
  • Preparing sales budgets and projections and approving expenditures
  • Tracking and analyzing sales statistics based on key quantitative metrics
  • Handling and resolving customer complaints regarding a product or service
  • Setting discount rates and determining price schedules
  • Advising distributors and dealers on policies and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)

Sales Manager Skills and Qualifications

  • Ability to set sales targets and achieve them effectively
  • Excellent interpersonal, customer service and communication skills
  • Experience using CRM to manage the sales process and forecast sales
  • Strong analytical skills to identify trends and sales patterns
  • Ability to guide and mentor sales representatives
  • Planning, organization, and problem-solving skills
  • You can be successful in this position if you:
  • Are self-motivated
  • Possess excellent one-on-one presentation skills
  • Assertive and results-oriented with a need to succeed
  • Highly organized with exceptional follow-through abilities
  • Outgoing personality that blends well with a fast-paced, goal-driven environment
  • Highly motivated, flexible and great attitude on life
  • Hold customer service as a top priority
  • Conduct business based on honesty and integrity

Compensation: Base Salary (based on experience, geography, and span of control) + commission and bonus plan

Total Pay: (Base + Commission) - $120,000 - $280,000 per year

#SALES1

Benefits:

 

  • 401(k)
  • Dental insurance
  • Health insurance
  • Paid time off
  • Vision insurance

 

Experience:

 

  • HVAC: 2 years (Preferred)
  • Sales management: 3 years (Required)

 

Work Location: In person

Ready to get started? Apply today!

raw.salaryDescription:
The big task
You will aid, diagnose, and repair, as well as maintain heating and cooling systems and lead customers to informed and confident buying decisions by providing an extraordinary customer experience.

Key sub tasks

  • Maintain communication with dispatch, your manager, parts and installation teams.
  • Keep your company truck clean, inside and out.
  • Keep your truck inventory up to date.
  • Properly complete paperwork.
  • Join the on-call rotation.
  • Maintain a clean and professional appearance.
  • Have and maintain a clean driving record.
  • Participate in training allowing you to grow and develop as a professional.
  • Have or be willing to get the proper certifications. We can help you with this.

Skills and experience
If you can achieve the above and you find it fun and challenging - you have just the right amount of skill and experience.

What we offer

Benefits:

  • Company vehicle
  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance
  • Paid vacation and holidays
  • 401K with employer match
  • Company paid Short-term and Long-term disability insurance
  • Company paid Life Insurance
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Learning & Professional Development Opportunities
  • A family. This is last on the list because it’s most important. We care about our team and expect you to bring that same caring when you join. We do a lot more than just work together. You’ll come to love our company outings, and you’ll build life-long friendships at AA Service Co.

Requirements

In return for this great opportunity we are looking for:

  • Must have a clean driver license.
  • Mechanical skills, proficient working with tools.
  • Enjoy helping people. Be polite and respectful in our customers homes and with how you communicate with your colleagues.
  • Be resourceful. Focus on solutions, not on problems.
  • Attention to details. Looking for employees who take pride in the quality of their work.
  • Great attitude. Looking for employees who whistle and smile while they work. Negative attitudes need not apply.
  • Looking for apprentices who want to quickly learn and grow. Our top technicians earn over $100,000 annually. This could be you in under 3 years.

Job Type: Full-time

Benefits:

  • 401(k) matching
  • Dental insurance
  • Employee discount
  • Health insurance
  • Health savings account
  • Life insurance
  • Paid time off
  • Referral program
  • Retirement plan
  • Vision insurance

raw.descriptionPlain:
Are You Ready to Lead From the Front?
 
Glasco Heating & Air Conditioning is seeking a strong, field-driven Service Leader to oversee and grow our residential HVAC service department in South Windsor, CT.
 
We are looking for a CT-licensed HVAC professional who combines technical expertise with leadership ability. This is an opportunity for a proven Service Manager, Service Lead, Technical Field Representative, or Senior Service Technician with reporting and team oversight experience who is ready to elevate performance, accountability, and customer satisfaction.
If you believe leadership means setting the standard, mentoring technicians, driving revenue ethically, and delivering exceptional customer experiences — we want to talk to you.
 
What You’ll Do
As our Service Manager, you will serve as a leader, coach, technical authority, and revenue driver for the service department.
 
Leadership & Team Development
Lead, mentor, and hold accountable service technicians to achieve performance and customer satisfaction goals
Conduct ride-alongs, field evaluations, and technical training
Recruit, interview, and onboard new technicians
Run daily huddles, weekly meetings, and 1:1 performance reviews
Provide hands-on field support during peak demand
Ensure a culture focused on safety, professionalism, and accountability
 
Operational Oversight
Oversee scheduling, dispatch coordination, and technician productivity
Review invoices, job documentation, photos, and reports for accuracy and profitability
Monitor KPIs including revenue, conversion rates, callbacks, and technician efficiency
Prepare/review payroll, commissions, and performance incentives
Assist in managing inventory and truck stock with warehouse coordination
Collaborate with call center and dispatch to maximize opportunity flow
Assist with price book updates and ensure profit margins are maintained
 
Financial & Performance Management
Help develop annual budgets and manage departmental expenses
Drive revenue growth through coaching and ethical upselling practices
Track and report department performance metrics
Ensure staffing levels align with seasonal demand
 
Required Qualifications
Must hold a valid Connecticut HVAC license
EPA Universal Certification
Valid driver’s license with clean driving record
Minimum 3–5 years in HVAC supervisory, lead technician, or management role
5–8+ years of hands-on HVAC service experience
Strong knowledge of HVAC systems, diagnostics, repairs, duct modifications, and system design
Experience reviewing reports, job costing, and technician performance metrics
ServiceTitan experience strongly preferred
Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Excel, Word)
Knowledge of OSHA safety standards
Ability to work Saturdays when business demands require
Willingness to perform local travel (~25%)
 
Ideal Background Profiles
We encourage candidates with experience as:
HVAC Service Manager
Service Lead / Lead Technician
Technical Field Representative
Senior Service Technician with reporting and coaching responsibilities
 
What We Offer:
At Glasco Heating & Air Conditioning, we don’t just offer jobs — we build careers.
401(k) with company match
Health, Dental & Vision Insurance
Health Savings Account (HSA)
Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick, Personal)
Parental Leave
Short-Term & Long-Term Disability
Company-Paid Life Insurance
Ongoing training & professional development
Friends & Family Service Discounts
Year-round work stability
Performance bonuses & commission opportunities
 
Schedule:
Full-time
Monday–Friday
Saturdays as needed
Year-round employment
 
The Leader We’re Looking For:
A licensed CT HVAC professional
Confident leading from the field, not just the office
Data-driven and comfortable reviewing performance metrics
Organized, decisive, and accountable
Passionate about developing technicians
Focused on customer satisfaction and revenue growth
Experienced with ServiceTitan or similar field service software
If you're ready to take ownership of a growing service department and make a measurable impact in South Windsor and surrounding communities, we’d love to connect.

·        Ability to lift 50 pounds.
·        High School diploma or GED
·        Current and unrestricted driver’s license.
·        Professional set of tools.
·        Physical ability to perform all requirements associated with this position.

We keep on growing because we only hire the best, and our customers love us for it. We’ve been at this a long time here in Rocky Mount, Roanoke and Danville. You’ve probably seen our trucks and our ads. What you don’t know is what it’s like to be a part of a team like this. How much you feel appreciated when you don’t cut corners. How much we inspire ongoing training and education. How it feels to have customers rave about you and demand that you’re the only technician that works in their home. How much you can earn when you truly are the best. People often come to us looking for a job. They stay with us because they find a fulfilling career, room to grow, and opportunities to excel. 

Why we need you

Because we offer state of the art customer experiences, we need a top of the line HVAC technician who genuinely care about the customer and are not looking for “just a job,” but a career.

The big task

You will diagnose and repair heating and cooling systems and lead customers to informed and confident buying decisions by providing an extraordinary customer experience.

Key sub tasks

• Maintain communication with dispatch, your manager, parts and installation teams.

• Keep your company truck clean, inside and out.

• Keep your truck inventory up to date.

• Properly complete paperwork.

• Join the on-call rotation.

• Maintain a clean and professional appearance.

• Have and maintain a clean driving record.

• Participate in training allowing you to grow and develop as a professional.

• Have or be willing to get the proper certifications. We can help you with this.

Skills and experience

If you can achieve the above and you find it fun and challenging - you have just the right amount of skill and experience.

What we offer

  • Competitive pay plus incentives
  • Medical Insurance – We offer health, dental, vision, life insurance, short term and long term disability.
  • Work life balance
  • 401k Plan 
  • Advancement opportunities

 

Our Guiding Principles

Customers First

Self-Driven

Positive Can-Do Attitude

Knowledge Sharing 

Above & Beyond 

Learn more about us

If you want to be part of something bigger than just a job – make this career move and find exactly what you’re looking for. You will work in a place where you will be appreciated by your team and customers, and where your work has a direct effect on the success of the company. If this sounds like you, spend a little time learning about Davis Heating, Air, Plumbing & Electric by visiting www.davisheat.com. When you're ready, please follow the directions to apply for this position.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Dave's World

Knowledge of Mitsubishi, Lennox, Samsung and other models.
Strong diagnostic and troubleshooting ability

Experience with furnaces, boilers, heat pumps, mini splits, and AC systems 
Knowledge of electrical and low-voltage troubleshooting and refrigerant concerns
Ability to explain technical issues in a way customers understand 
Comfortable presenting repair and replacement options 
Valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record 
Service Titan or similar field service software experience is a plus 
 
What Success Looks Like 
Shows up ready to work and follows through on commitments 
Takes pride in quality work and attention to detail 
Communicates clearly with customers and teammates 
Works safely and follows established processes 
Takes ownership, solves problems, and is willing to keep learning 
 
Benefits 
Company-provided phone/tablet  
Tool and safety equipment support 
Medical, dental, and vision insurance 
401(k) with company match 
Paid time off and paid holidays 
Company-paid life and disability insurance 
Paid training and professional development 
Opportunities for career growth and advancement

raw.descriptionPlain:
Residential Journeyman Electrician| Scarborough, ME
Dave's World
Want steady work, good people, and a company where you can actually build a career? Welcome to Dave’s World. 
We’re growing across Maine and looking for HVAC, plumbing, and electrical pros who like working with their hands, solving problems, and helping customers. Whether you’ve been in the trades for years or you’re ready for your next step, there’s room to grow here. 
Come join the crew and let’s get to work.
 
Job Description
Perform electrical service, maintenance, repairs, and installations 
Install and replace panels, breakers, outlets, switches, fixtures, fans, and other electrical components 
Troubleshoot wiring, circuits, controls, and electrical systems 
Perform electrical upgrades and code corrections 
Present repair and replacement options clearly to homeowners 
Complete estimates, invoices, and job documentation 
Maintain a clean and organized company vehicle and work area 
Follow NEC, local codes, safety procedures, and company standards 
Provide excellent customer service on every call 
Skills & Experience for Our Next Electrician 
3+ years of residential electrical service experience preferred 
Strong troubleshooting and diagnostic skills 
Knowledge of residential electrical systems and current electrical codes 
Ability to read wiring diagrams and use electrical testing equipment 
Strong customer communication skills 
Comfortable presenting solutions and options to homeowners 
Applicable electrical license required based on state/local regulations 
Valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record 
Field service software experience is a plus 
 
What Success Looks Like for Our Next Electrician 
Shows up ready to work and follows through on commitments 
Takes pride in quality work and attention to detail 
Communicates clearly with customers and teammates 
Works safely and follows established processes 
Takes ownership, solves problems, and is willing to keep learning 
 
Benefits for Our Next Electrician 
Company-provided phone/tablet (for eligible field positions) 
Tool and safety equipment support 
Medical, dental, and vision insurance 
401(k) with company match 
Paid time off and paid holidays 
Company-paid life and disability insurance 
Paid training and professional development 
Opportunities for career growth and advancement 
 
Requirements:
Must have Journeyman's license in Maine

jobs.description: Lead HVAC Installer Burns & McBride Home Comfort | New Castle, DE Experienced HVAC installers know that great work requires more than technical skill. It takes the right materials, clear communication, strong coordination, and a company that gives its field teams the support needed to complete installations correctly. At Burns & McBride Home Comfort, we’re looking for an experienced Lead HVAC Installer who takes pride in craftsmanship, leads by example, and wants to work for a company that values quality over shortcuts. You’ll take ownership of residential installation projects, guide apprentices and helpers, and work closely with our sales, service, warehouse, and operations teams to keep jobs moving smoothly. You’ll have the opportunity to make decisions in the field, develop less-experienced team members, and deliver installations you’re proud to put your name on. With steady work, strong operational support, and opportunities to continue growing, Burns & McBride offers experienced installers a place to build the next stage of their careers. What You’ll Do Lead residential HVAC replacement and installation projects from start to finish. Install furnaces, boilers, air conditioners, heat pumps, air handlers, mini-splits, thermostats, and indoor air quality equipment. Complete ductwork modifications, refrigerant piping, condensate drainage, venting, gas piping, wiring, and system connections. Direct, train, and support apprentices and installation helpers. Perform equipment startups, charging, airflow verification, testing, and commissioning. Troubleshoot installation issues and ensure work meets manufacturer requirements, applicable codes, and company standards. Review job information and communicate equipment, material, or scope concerns promptly. Protect customers’ homes and maintain a clean, safe, and professional jobsite. Explain system operation, maintenance expectations, and warranty information to homeowners. Complete accurate job documentation, equipment records, and required photos. Coordinate with sales, service, dispatch, warehouse, and leadership teams. Maintain assigned vehicles, tools, equipment, materials, and inventory. What We’re Looking For Previous experience leading residential HVAC replacement and installation projects. Ability to independently complete residential HVAC installations from start to finish. Strong knowledge of heating and cooling equipment, ductwork, refrigeration, airflow, venting, and system commissioning. Strong troubleshooting, leadership, and jobsite problem-solving abilities. Ability to train and direct apprentices or installation helpers. Commitment to quality workmanship, safety, and code compliance. Strong communication and customer service skills. EPA Universal Certification required. Applicable trade licenses or certifications preferred. Comfortable using tablets, mobile applications, and field service software. Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record. Ability to perform physical work in attics, basements, crawl spaces, mechanical rooms, and outdoor conditions. Why Work at Burns & McBride? Competitive compensation based on experience Performance-based earning opportunities Steady, year-round installation demand Strong office, warehouse, and operational support Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance 401(k) with Company Match Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays Company-Provided Vehicle Company Phone or Tablet Uniforms Provided Ongoing Paid Technical and Leadership Training Career Advancement Opportunities The opportunity to train and develop future HVAC professionals A professional environment that values quality, accountability, and teamwork What Success Looks Like Success in this role means taking ownership of each installation, delivering clean and dependable workmanship, and ensuring every system operates correctly before the job is complete. You’ll set the standard for the installation team, develop less-experienced employees, and help Burns & McBride continue earning customer trust through quality, professionalism, and consistent execution. #HVAC1

At Dave's World, we're looking for an organized, energetic leader to oversee the daily operations of our branch. As our Location Manager, you'll keep the office running smoothly, support our field teams, and ensure every customer receives an exceptional experience. If you're a strong leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment, understands the HVAC industry, and enjoys building high-performing teams, we'd love to meet you. What You'll Do Lead the day-to-day operations of the branch while supporting the Regional Manager. Oversee the Customer Service, Dispatch, Installation, Service, Plumbing, and Electrical teams. Recruit, train, coach, and develop office staff while creating a positive, accountable culture. Keep the installation calendar full and ensure service and installation schedules are optimized for efficiency. Coordinate technician workloads and maintain dispatch procedures to maximize productivity. Schedule sales consultations and installations while partnering with the sales team. Respond to customer concerns and ensure every customer receives a five-star experience. Collect customer payments and assist with financing applications when needed. Monitor branch performance, report key metrics, and help drive revenue and operational goals. Strong knowledge of residential HVAC systems and terminology—you should be comfortable speaking with customers and supporting technicians. Experience leading customer service, dispatch, and office operations. Exceptional organizational, leadership, and multitasking skills. Outstanding customer service and communication abilities. Experience with scheduling, payroll, invoicing, and operational reporting. ServiceTitan experience is highly preferred. A hands-on leader who enjoys solving problems, developing people, and driving results. Why Join Dave's World? Apply today and help Dave's World continue delivering exceptional service to homeowners every day!

Steady, year-round residential customer demand
Opportunity to serve as a key plumbing subject matter expert
Work spanning Connecticut and neighboring New York markets
Strong dispatch, customer service, warehouse, and operational support
Company-provided vehicle
Company phone or tablet
Company-provided uniforms
Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
401(k) with Company Match
Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays
Ongoing Technical and Professional Development
Opportunity to mentor and develop other plumbing professionals
Career advancement within a growing home-services organization

Complete plumbing, drain, water heater, piping, fixture, pump, valve, and related service work.
Handle complex plumbing calls and provide technical guidance when other plumbers need support.
Perform work in accordance with applicable Connecticut and New York plumbing codes, permitting requirements, and manufacturer specifications.
Serve as a plumbing subject matter expert and resource for technicians in the field.
Help establish and maintain high standards for workmanship, safety, code compliance, and customer service.
Review challenging jobs, callbacks, or quality concerns and help determine appropriate solutions.
Perform field quality checks and provide coaching when opportunities for improvement are identified.
Mentor apprentices and experienced plumbers to strengthen their technical skills and diagnostic abilities.
Participate in interviewing and evaluating prospective plumbing team members.
Provide ongoing feedback to help ensure plumbers meet expectations for productivity, workmanship, professionalism, and customer care.
Lead by example while continuing to run productive residential service calls.
Clearly explain diagnoses and available repair or replacement options to homeowners.
Obtain customer authorization before beginning work and collect payment when appropriate.
Complete accurate estimates, invoices, service notes, photos, and required documentation.
Maintain a clean, organized, properly stocked company vehicle.
Communicate parts, scheduling, permitting, or return-trip needs promptly.
Work closely with dispatch, customer service, warehouse, and location leadership to keep work moving efficiently.
What We’re Looking For
Active Connecticut P-1 Plumbing & Piping Contractor license strongly preferred.
Master Plumber licensing that supports work in Westchester County, New York strongly preferred.
Putnam County, NY licensing is a plus.
Extensive residential plumbing service, repair, and installation experience.
Strong knowledge of plumbing codes, permitting requirements, and residential plumbing systems.
Ability to independently diagnose and complete complex plumbing work.
Strong technical troubleshooting and problem-solving ability.
Ability to coach, mentor, and provide constructive feedback to other plumbers.
Previous experience providing field leadership or overseeing the work of other technicians preferred.
Ability to evaluate workmanship and identify safety, code, or quality concerns.
Strong communication and customer service skills.
Confidence explaining technical findings and appropriate solutions to homeowners.
Professional judgment and the ability to lead by example.
Strong organization and documentation skills.
Comfortable using tablets, mobile applications, and field-service software.
Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record.
What Success Looks Like
Success in this role means being one of the people Astacio can count on when the plumbing work is difficult, the technical answer isn’t obvious, or another plumber needs guidance.
You’ll continue producing in the field while helping raise the performance of the team around you. Your work will set the example for quality, safety, code compliance, professionalism, and customer care.
You’ll help develop other plumbers, support strong hiring decisions, reduce callbacks and quality issues, and ensure our customers receive plumbing work that meets the standards expected from Astacio.
Ready for What’s Next?
If you’re an experienced Master Plumber who still enjoys working in the field but is ready to have a greater impact through your experience, licensing, and leadership, we want to talk to you.
Apply today and bring your expertise to Astacio Plumbing, Heating, Cooling & Electrical.

raw.salaryDescription:
The Opportunity 

As Multi-Site Sales Manager, you'll own sales performance for two branch locations in the same Greater Hartford market. Think of yourself as the connective tissue between two teams that are great on their own but even better working from the same game plan. You'll split your time across both locations — coaching in the field, calibrating standards in the conference room, and reporting on results at the business level. 

This role is built for someone who wants scale and significance — a bigger book of business, a bigger team to develop, and a direct line to the kind of revenue impact that gets noticed at the top of the company. 

What You'll Do 

  • Lead, coach, and hold accountable comfort advisors and outside sales reps across two branch locations in the Greater Hartford market 

  • Build one consistent sales playbook — process, messaging, and standards — that works seamlessly at both locations while still flexing to each site's local dynamics 

  • Drive revenue growth through in-field ride-alongs, live coaching, and performance management at both locations 

  • Recruit, hire, and develop the next generation of sales talent and team leads, building bench strength at each site 

  • Monitor KPIs, close rates, and sales metrics location-by-location — spotting what's working at your stronger site and replicating it at the other 

  • Partner with branch GMs and operations leaders at each location to align sales capacity with install and service capacity 

  • Develop and execute sales strategy and growth initiatives across both locations to expand market share in Greater Hartford 

  • Prepare and manage sales budgets and projections across both P&Ls, and approve expenditures within your authority 

  • Set the tone on customer experience — make sure every homeowner at either location gets the same tailored, trustworthy experience 

  • Step in personally to resolve escalated customer concerns when a deal or relationship needs a senior hand 

What You Bring 

  • 5+ years of in-home or residential sales experience, with 3–5 years leading a sales team (experience leading teams across more than one location strongly preferred) 

  • A track record of setting aggressive sales targets and actually hitting them — not just setting them 

  • Comfort managing through layers — coaching team leads who coach reps — rather than only managing individuals directly 

  • Strong CRM fluency for pipeline management and forecasting across two locations 

  • Sharp analytical instincts: you can look at sales data from two branches and immediately see the story it's telling 

  • A willingness to split your week between two branch locations within the Greater Hartford market 

  • Planning, organization, and problem-solving skills that hold up when you're juggling two sites' priorities at once 

  • Residential HVAC, plumbing, or electrical industry experience is a strong plus 

You'll Thrive in This Role If You're... 

  • Self-motivated and energized by ownership, not just oversight 

  • Assertive, competitive, and genuinely uncomfortable with “good enough” 

  • Outgoing and persuasive one-on-one, with the presence to win a room of reps or a room of GMs 

  • Highly organized, with the follow-through to keep multiple branches on track at once 

  • Someone who treats honesty and customer trust as non-negotiable, even under pressure to close 

Compensation & Benefits 

Compensation: Base salary (based on experience and scope of locations managed) + commission and bonus plan 

Total Pay: $140,000 – $320,000 per year (Base + Commission + Bonus) 

  • 401(k) 

  • Company car 

  • Dental insurance 

  • Employee discount 

  • Health insurance 

  • Paid time off 

  • Parental leave 

  • Tuition reimbursement 

  • Vision insurance 

  • Quarterly bonus

Lead, coach, and develop department leaders, senior technicians, and installation leads.
Hold regular 1:1s focused on performance, development, and removing operational barriers.

Drive improvement across key field metrics including labor efficiency, callbacks, first-call resolution, job completion, average ticket, and technician utilization.
Use performance data to identify specific problems and implement corrective action.
Ensure consistent execution of customer service, jobsite, vehicle, and documentation standards.
Improve job-costing accuracy by ensuring labor, materials, and technician time are captured correctly.
Lead callback and quality reviews with a focus on preventing repeat issues.

Maintain a proactive safety culture across HVAC and plumbing operations.
Ensure teams follow company policies, OSHA requirements, and trade-specific regulations.
Oversee vehicle and equipment readiness and address issues that could impact field capacity.
Support budgeting, headcount planning, and capacity forecasting with field-level insight.
Serve as a trusted operational partner to the General Manager or Associate Vice President.

Proven field operations leadership experience in HVAC, plumbing, home services, or a comparable skilled-trades environment.
Track record of developing frontline leaders and improving technician performance.
Strong understanding of field KPIs, labor efficiency, callbacks, utilization, and profitability.
Experience using ServiceTitan or a comparable field-service platform.
Strong leadership presence with a willingness to spend significant time in the field.
Clear communicator who can coach, hold people accountable, and make decisions with urgency.
Working knowledge of safety and OSHA requirements.
Bachelor’s degree preferred, but strong field leadership experience carries more weight.

Success means the operation runs effectively without constant intervention from the General Manager.
Technicians are productive. Install crews are prepared. Callbacks decline. Jobs are completed on time. Field leaders know their numbers and understand what is expected of them. Problems are addressed quickly, and the same operational issues don’t continue repeating.
Most importantly, you’ll build stronger leaders and stronger field teams while helping Sila consistently deliver the level of service our customers expect.
Ready to Lead from the Field?
If you know how to turn a group of talented HVAC and plumbing professionals into a high-performing operation—and you’d rather be where the work happens than managing from behind a desk—we want to talk to you.
Apply today and help lead field operations at Sila Heating & Air Conditioning in Beltsville, MD.

Use performance data to identify specific problems and implement corrective action.
Ensure consistent execution of customer service, jobsite, vehicle, and documentation standards.
Improve job-costing accuracy by ensuring labor, materials, and technician time are captured correctly.
Lead callback and quality reviews with a focus on preventing repeat issues.
Safety & Operational Excellence
Maintain a proactive safety culture across HVAC and plumbing operations.
Ensure teams follow company policies, OSHA requirements, and trade-specific regulations.
Oversee vehicle and equipment readiness and address issues that could impact field capacity.
Support budgeting, headcount planning, and capacity forecasting with field-level insight.
Serve as a trusted operational partner to the General Manager or Associate Vice President.
What We’re Looking For
Proven field operations leadership experience in HVAC, plumbing, home services, or a comparable skilled-trades environment.
Track record of developing frontline leaders and improving technician performance.
Strong understanding of field KPIs, labor efficiency, callbacks, utilization, and profitability.
Experience using ServiceTitan or a comparable field-service platform.
Strong leadership presence with a willingness to spend significant time in the field.
Clear communicator who can coach, hold people accountable, and make decisions with urgency.
Working knowledge of safety and OSHA requirements.
Bachelor’s degree preferred, but strong field leadership experience carries more weight.
What Success Looks Like
Success means the operation runs effectively without constant intervention from the General Manager.
Technicians are productive. Install crews are prepared. Callbacks decline. Jobs are completed on time. Field leaders know their numbers and understand what is expected of them. Problems are addressed quickly, and the same operational issues don’t continue repeating.
Most importantly, you’ll build stronger leaders and stronger field teams while helping Sila consistently deliver the level of service our customers expect.
Ready to Lead from the Field?
If you know how to turn a group of talented HVAC and plumbing professionals into a high-performing operation—and you’d rather be where the work happens than managing from behind a desk—we want to talk to you.
Apply today and help lead field operations at Sila Heating & Air Conditioning in Beltsville, MD.

jobs.description: HVAC Sales / Comfort Advisor – Boston, MA You know HVAC. You know how to sell. And you know the difference between “selling” and actually helping a homeowner make the right decision. Sound like you? Keep reading. Sila Services is looking for an experienced HVAC Sales/Comfort Advisor who can walk into a home, connect with the customer, understand what they need, and put together the right solution. We’ll bring you the opportunities — you bring the HVAC knowledge, personality, and ability to close! What You’ll Be Doing You’ll meet with homeowners, evaluate their heating and cooling needs, and sell complete HVAC solutions including furnaces, boilers, heat pumps, central AC, mini splits, and more. You’ll build options that make sense for the customer, explain the differences in a way they can actually understand, and help them feel confident about their decision. You’ll also manage your opportunities and follow-ups in ServiceTitan and work closely with our install and operations teams to make sure what you sell turns into a great customer experience. We’d Love to Talk to You If You... Have HVAC or home services sales experience, understand residential HVAC equipment, and have a track record of closing high-ticket in-home sales. You should be comfortable with good/better/best options, financing conversations, follow-up, and selling complete system replacements. ServiceTitan experience is a big plus. Most importantly, you need to like people, like selling, and like winning. Why Sila? Because great salespeople should have the opportunity to sell, earn, and grow. Sila is growing, we have a strong team behind you, and we’re looking for someone who wants to be part of that growth. If you can build trust at the kitchen table, know your way around an HVAC system, and love the feeling of closing a great sale — we want to meet you.

jobs.title: Plumber
jobs.description: Residential Service Plumber JSP Home Services | Kingston, NY Experienced plumbers have options. The right opportunity should offer more than a full schedule—it should provide steady customer demand, strong office support, quality tools, continued training, and a company that respects the expertise you bring into every home. At JSP Home Services, we’re looking for an experienced Residential Service Plumber who takes pride in accurate diagnostics, dependable workmanship, and creating a professional customer experience. You’ll have the support of a knowledgeable dispatch and operations team, the resources needed to work efficiently, and opportunities to continue growing your skills and earning potential. As a Residential Service Plumber, you’ll diagnose, repair, and improve residential plumbing systems while helping homeowners understand their options and make informed decisions. You’ll take ownership of your service calls while working with an experienced home services team committed to delivering dependable results. If you’re looking for year-round work, strong operational support, and a company that values quality, accountability, and doing the job right, JSP Home Services may be the right place for your next move. What You’ll Do Diagnose, repair, and maintain residential plumbing systems. Service and install water heaters, faucets, toilets, fixtures, disposals, sump pumps, ejector pumps, and related equipment. Repair water lines, drain lines, leaks, valves, piping, and other plumbing components. Perform plumbing inspections and identify code, safety, or performance concerns. Clearly explain findings and recommend appropriate repair or replacement options. Obtain customer approval before completing work and collect payment when appropriate. Complete accurate estimates, service notes, photos, and follow-up documentation. Communicate parts, scheduling, and return-trip needs promptly to the office. Protect customers’ homes and maintain a clean, professional work area. Maintain assigned vehicles, tools, materials, and truck inventory. Coordinate with dispatch, customer service, and other field teams. Participate in required meetings, technical training, and professional development. What We’re Looking For Previous residential plumbing service and repair experience. Strong diagnostic and troubleshooting abilities. Knowledge of residential plumbing systems, fixtures, materials, and applicable codes. Ability to independently manage service calls from diagnosis through completion. Strong communication and customer service skills. Ability to explain technical findings and available options clearly to homeowners. Comfortable presenting service options and making appropriate recommendations. Commitment to safe, code-compliant, and high-quality work. Journeyman Plumber license or equivalent experience preferred. Comfortable using tablets, mobile applications, and field service software. Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record. Ability to perform physical work in basements, crawl spaces, bathrooms, and outdoor conditions. Why Work at JSP Home Services? Competitive compensation with performance-based earning opportunities Steady, year-round customer demand Strong dispatch, customer service, and operational support Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance 401(k) with Company Match Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays Company-Provided Vehicle Company Phone or Tablet Uniforms and Professional Tools Ongoing Paid Technical and Customer Service Training Career Advancement Opportunities Support from an experienced plumbing, HVAC, and electrical team A professional environment that values quality, accountability, and teamwork What Success Looks Like Success in this role means diagnosing plumbing problems accurately, completing dependable repairs and installations, and helping homeowners feel confident in the recommendations you provide. You’ll communicate professionally, document your work thoroughly, and help JSP Home Services continue earning customer trust through quality service and consistent follow-through.

jobs.description: Guy Smith Home Services - Norfolk, VA Residential Plumbing Apprentice Looking to get into plumbing with a company that will actually teach you the trade and keep you working? Guy Smith Home Services has been serving homeowners across the Norfolk and Hampton Roads area for decades. We’ve built our reputation by showing up, doing the job right, and standing behind our work—and that keeps our crews busy year-round. We’re looking for a Plumbing Apprentice who’s ready to learn, work hard, and build a real career. You’ll be out in the field alongside experienced plumbers, helping with installs and repairs, learning residential systems, and getting hands-on training every day. If you show up on time, take direction, and want to learn a trade that can set you up long-term, apply today! Apply today! Pay: $18 - $20/hr We don't just offer jobs—we build careers. Here’s why you’ll love being part of our team: Comprehensive Health Benefits: We offer affordable, high-quality health, dental, and vision insurance to keep you and your family covered. Paid Time Off ! We believe in the importance of rest and relaxation, so you start earning paid time off after 30 days of employment. 401(k) Plan with Company Match: Secure your future with our competitive 401(k) plan, including a generous company match. Parental Leave: We support our team members through all stages of life, including offering parental leave for new parents. Training and Development Opportunities: We’re committed to your professional growth with training at our new corporate training facility! Yearly Performance Reviews: We believe in continuous improvement and offer yearly performance reviews to ensure you’re on track and rewarded for your hard work. In this role, you'll be responsible for: Assist with providing comprehensive plumbing inspections for customers. Offer upgrade options based on plumbing inspections findings. Assist with repairing or replace broken drainage lines, clogged drains, faucets etc. Assist with locating and repair issues with water supply lines (e.g. leaks) Assist with reading blueprints and drawings to understand or plan the layout of plumbing, waste disposal and water supply systems Assist with cutting , assembling and installing pipes and tubes with attention to existing infrastructure (e.g. electrical wiring) Assist with installing and maintaining water supply systems Assist with repairing domestic appliances (e.g. washing machines) and fixtures (e.g. sinks) etc. Assist with installing waste disposal and sanitary systems with well-functioning DWV systems Skills and Requirements: Trade school graduate in plumbing a plus Service Titan experience a plus Ability to handle plumbing tools and equipment (pipe wrenches, pipe cutters, plungers etc.) Good communication and interpersonal skills Friendly with a great deal of patience Good physical condition and strength with the ability to work in awkward spaces

Join our tight-knit team and become part of a family-owned success story that's been going strong since 1982! We're a local legend, known for our top-notch service and unwavering commitment to customer satisfaction. Work for a company that is supportive and fun and wants to see you grow in your career. About the Program: My Plumber Plus is proud to offer an exciting opportunity for individuals looking to launch their careers in the skilled trades. Our Plumbing Academy Program is designed to train and develop junior/entry-level plumbing apprentices through a structured, hands-on learning experience. Position Overview: We are currently hiring entry-level Plumbing Apprentices who are eager to learn and grow in the plumbing trade. This position begins with a 3–6 month introductory period where apprentices will: Assist experienced plumbing technicians on job sites (including running parts and tools) Work in our warehouse to gain foundational knowledge of parts, tools, and operations After successfully completing the initial period, apprentices who demonstrate strong interest and aptitude may be invited to join the Plumbing Academy, a 3–6 month robust training program that includes: Online technical courses In-house training with seasoned professionals Ride-alongs with licensed plumbing technicians Preferred Qualifications: 1–2 years of experience in warehousing, logistics, dispatch, automotive, delivery driving, data entry, customer service, or related roles Aspirations of entering the plumbing trade (or a similar skilled trade) Clean driving record (no negative points; positive points only) Preferably 21 years of age or older Ambitious with strong initiative—able to take ownership of tasks and daily operations Eager to learn and grow in a fast-paced environment Excellent attendance and time management skills Strong communication skills and attention to detail Willing to go above and beyond by learning new skills outside their core responsibilities Open to cross-training on the dispatch desk Willing and able to work overtime as needed What We Offer: Paid, hands-on training and mentorship Career development through a structured program A clear path toward becoming a licensed plumbing technician The opportunity to join a well-established and growing company A collaborative and fast-paced work environment Apply Today: Start your career in plumbing with My Plumber Plus! Applicants who have previously expressed interest will be contacted to schedule interviews. New applicants are encouraged to apply now and take the first step toward a rewarding future in the trades. Pay: $18/hr to start

Key Sub Tasks • MUST HAVE AT LEAST 2 YEAR MINIMUM OF PLUMBING EXPERIENCE. Maintain communication with dispatch, your manager, parts and installation teams. • Keep your company truck clean, inside and out. • Keep your truck inventory up to date. • Properly complete paperwork. • Join the on-call rotation. • Maintain a clean and professional appearance. • Have and maintain a clean driving record. • Participate in training allowing you to grow and develop as a professional. • Have or be willing to get the proper certifications. We care about our team, and expect you to bring that same caring when you join. We do a lot more than just work together.   • 8:00 AM – 4:30 PM

lists.text: Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for Residential HVAC Service Technician:
lists.content:
• Customer Satisfaction: Provide clear explanations and educate customers about their HVAC systems, offering preventive maintenance tips and energy-saving recommendations. Maintain customer satisfaction rate through post-service surveys and feedback. Strive to exceed customer expectations and resolve any concerns promptly.
  • First-Time Fix Rate: Achieve a best-in-class first-time fix rate by accurately diagnosing issues, arriving fully prepared with necessary tools and parts, and effectively completing repairs during the initial service call.
  • Response Time: Respond to service requests within Sila's defined time frame. Timely response ensures customer comfort and builds trust.
  • Service Revenue Generation: Diagnose and troubleshoot HVAC equipment issues, recommending appropriate solutions and discussing options with customers. Consistently meet or exceed monthly service revenue targets, contributing to the company's financial growth and success. Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling additional services, products, or maintenance plans to customers during service visits.
  • Service Agreement Enrollment: Successfully enroll customers in Sila’s service agreements, promoting long-term customer relationships and recurring revenue.
  • Productivity and Utilization: Maintain a high level of productivity by efficiently managing work orders, minimizing downtime, and maximizing billable hours.
  • Technical Excellence: Perform routine maintenance, inspections, and repairs on residential HVAC systems to ensure optimal performance and efficiency. Demonstrate continuous improvement in technical skills and knowledge through training, certifications, and staying updated on industry best practices.
  • Inventory Management: Keep track of service vehicle inventory and parts stock, ensuring accuracy and minimizing unnecessary expenses due to missing or overstocked items.
  • Safety Adherence: Maintain a perfect safety record by following all safety protocols and guidelines. Ensure zero safety incidents or accidents within the performance period.
  • Documentation Accuracy: Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of service calls, work performed, and parts used in the Service Titan platform.
  • Team Collaboration: Collaborate effectively with team members, sharing knowledge and assisting colleagues as needed. Strive to maintain a positive team dynamic and contribute to a supportive work environment.
  • Professionalism and Communication: Uphold professional communication and appearance at all times when interacting with customers.
  • Attendance and Punctuality: Maintain a consistent record of punctuality and attendance, arriving at scheduled appointments on time and adhering to the assigned work schedule.
  • Additional Duties as Assigned

jobs.description: HVAC Service Technician Absolute Air Services | Portland, CT A great HVAC Service Technician does more than repair equipment. They solve problems, earn homeowners’ trust, and provide the kind of service customers remember long after the call is complete. At Absolute Air Services, we’re looking for an experienced, Connecticut-licensed HVAC Service Technician who takes pride in accurate diagnostics, dependable repairs, and exceptional customer care. You’ll have steady, year-round work, strong support from the office and field teams, and the opportunity to continue developing your technical skills. You’ll diagnose and service residential heating and cooling systems, clearly explain your findings, and help homeowners make informed decisions about their comfort. If you’re looking for a company that values your expertise, supports your success, and recognizes quality work, we want to talk to you. What You’ll Do Diagnose, troubleshoot, repair, and maintain residential HVAC systems. raw.salaryDescription:
N.E.T.R Inc.
 
North Andover, MA
 
Residential HVAC Service Technician
 
Pay: $30/hr - $40/hr
 
At NETR, a Sila Services Company, we are an established residential and commercial heating and cooling company located in North Andover, MA that has been in business for over three decades. Our ability to retain quality employees speaks to our commitment to hire motivated people and provide exceptional on the job and professional training. Our explosive growth has opened the need for an experienced Residential HVAC Service Technician to join our team.
 
We don't just offer jobs—we build careers. Here’s why you’ll love being part of our team:
 
Industry-Leading Compensation: We believe in rewarding excellence. Our Installers are amongst the best paid in the area!
Fully Stocked Warehouse & Parts Runners: We ensure you have the tools and support you need to excel, with a fully stocked warehouse and parts runners at your service.
New Clean Fully Stocked Truck: Drive in style with a new, clean, fully stocked TAKE-HOME truck that’s ready for any job.
Comprehensive Health Benefits: We offer affordable, high-quality health, dental, and vision insurance to keep you and your family covered.
Paid Time Off Starting Day 1! We believe in the importance of rest and relaxation, so you start earning paid time off from your first day.
401(k) Plan with Company Match: Secure your future with our competitive 401(k) plan, including a generous company match.
Parental Leave: We support our team members through all stages of life, including offering parental leave for new parents.
Tool and Boot Allowance: We provide a tool and boot allowance to replace the things you use the most to get the job done.
Training and Development Opportunities: We’re committed to your professional growth with training at our new Service Professionals Academy & Resources Center!
Yearly Performance Reviews: We believe in continuous improvement and offer yearly performance reviews to ensure you’re on track and rewarded for your hard work.
** The best time to find a great job is when you already have a good job. **
 
Primary Duties and Responsibilities:
 
Provides heating and cooling service, repairs, and maintenance. This includes HVAC, heat pumps, ducted systems, boilers, etc.
Communicates all information to the office by opening/closing jobs in electronic scheduling system to include but not limited to, job arrival, job completion, follow up notes/summary of work completed, etc.
Obtains the customer’s approval for work and obtains payment on-site as appropriate.
Maintains clean, neat vehicles and job sites and projects a clean, well-groomed professional appearance always.
Assumes responsibility for trucks, diagnostic tools, and uniforms.
Serves as a teacher and leads by example to apprentices on the job site.
Attends group meetings and training, as needed. Participates in monthly and special company meetings, as appropriate.
Uses good judgment and self-control in areas wherein the company entrusts him/her to maintain company and customer confidentiality.
Establish a sound positive work relationship with all members of the ECS team. Must be able to listen and implement all suggested feedback received.
Required Skills and Abilities:
 
EPA Universal Certification
Prior heating and/or cooling experience in a residential capacity.
Ability to prioritize tasks and communicate with customers.
Demonstrated excellent communication conflict resolution and interpersonal skills.
Demonstrated ability to work as an effective team member and pitch in as needed.
Computer skills and use of electronic devices for scheduling, invoice creation and communication to staff and customers required.
Must be able to work on a ladder.
Must be able to lift 50 pounds.
Job Type: Full-time
 
Pay: $30.00 - $40.00 per hour
 
Benefits:
 
 
401(k)
401(k) matching
Company truck
Dental insurance
Employee discount
Fuel card
Health insurance
Health savings account
Life insurance
Paid time off
Parental leave
Referral program
Tools provided
Vision insurance
Schedule:
 
 
Monday to Friday
On call
Weekends as needed
Supplemental Pay:
 
 
Bonus opportunities
Commission pay
Signing bonus
Work Location: On the road

lists.text: Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for Residential HVAC Service Technician:
lists.content:
• Customer Satisfaction: Provide clear explanations and educate customers about their HVAC systems, offering preventive maintenance tips and energy-saving recommendations. Maintain customer satisfaction rate through post-service surveys and feedback. Strive to exceed customer expectations and resolve any concerns promptly.
  • First-Time Fix Rate: Achieve a best-in-class first-time fix rate by accurately diagnosing issues, arriving fully prepared with necessary tools and parts, and effectively completing repairs during the initial service call.
  • Response Time: Respond to service requests within Nashoba Air & BoilerWorks' defined time frame. Timely response ensures customer comfort and builds trust.
  • Service Revenue Generation: Diagnose and troubleshoot HVAC equipment issues, recommending appropriate solutions and discussing options with customers. Consistently meet or exceed monthly service revenue targets, contributing to the company's financial growth and success. Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling additional services, products, or maintenance plans to customers during service visits.
  • Service Agreement Enrollment: Successfully enroll customers in Nashoba Air & BoilerWorks' service agreements, promoting long-term customer relationships and recurring revenue.
  • Productivity and Utilization: Maintain a high level of productivity by efficiently managing work orders, minimizing downtime, and maximizing billable hours.
  • Technical Excellence: Perform routine maintenance, inspections, and repairs on residential HVAC systems to ensure optimal performance and efficiency. Demonstrate continuous improvement in technical skills and knowledge through training, certifications, and staying updated on industry best practices.
  • Inventory Management: Keep track of service vehicle inventory and parts stock, ensuring accuracy and minimizing unnecessary expenses due to missing or overstocked items.
  • Safety Adherence: Maintain a perfect safety record by following all safety protocols and guidelines. Ensure zero safety incidents or accidents within the performance period.
  • Documentation Accuracy: Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of service calls, work performed, and parts used in the Service Titan platform.
  • Team Collaboration: Collaborate effectively with team members, sharing knowledge and assisting colleagues as needed. Strive to maintain a positive team dynamic and contribute to a supportive work environment.
  • Professionalism and Communication: Uphold professional communication and appearance at all times when interacting with customers.
  • Attendance and Punctuality: Maintain a consistent record of punctuality and attendance, arriving at scheduled appointments on time and adhering to the assigned work schedule.
  • Additional Duties as Assigned

lists.text: Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for Residential HVAC Service Technician:
lists.content:
• Customer Satisfaction: Provide clear explanations and educate customers about their HVAC systems, offering preventive maintenance tips and energy-saving recommendations. Maintain customer satisfaction rate through post-service surveys and feedback. Strive to exceed customer expectations and resolve any concerns promptly.
  • First-Time Fix Rate: Achieve a best-in-class first-time fix rate by accurately diagnosing issues, arriving fully prepared with necessary tools and parts, and effectively completing repairs during the initial service call.
  • Response Time: Respond to service requests within Auchinachie's defined time frame. Timely response ensures customer comfort and builds trust.
  • Service Revenue Generation: Diagnose and troubleshoot HVAC equipment issues, recommending appropriate solutions and discussing options with customers. Consistently meet or exceed monthly service revenue targets, contributing to the company's financial growth and success. Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling additional services, products, or maintenance plans to customers during service visits.
  • Service Agreement Enrollment: Successfully enroll customers in Auchinachie’s service agreements, promoting long-term customer relationships and recurring revenue.
  • Productivity and Utilization: Maintain a high level of productivity by efficiently managing work orders, minimizing downtime, and maximizing billable hours.
  • Technical Excellence: Perform routine maintenance, inspections, and repairs on residential HVAC systems to ensure optimal performance and efficiency. Demonstrate continuous improvement in technical skills and knowledge through training, certifications, and staying updated on industry best practices.
  • Inventory Management: Keep track of service vehicle inventory and parts stock, ensuring accuracy and minimizing unnecessary expenses due to missing or overstocked items.
  • Safety Adherence: Maintain a perfect safety record by following all safety protocols and guidelines. Ensure zero safety incidents or accidents within the performance period.
  • Documentation Accuracy: Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of service calls, work performed, and parts used in the Service Titan platform.
  • Team Collaboration: Collaborate effectively with team members, sharing knowledge and assisting colleagues as needed. Strive to maintain a positive team dynamic and contribute to a supportive work environment.
  • Professionalism and Communication: Uphold professional communication and appearance at all times when interacting with customers.
  • Attendance and Punctuality: Maintain a consistent record of punctuality and attendance, arriving at scheduled appointments on time and adhering to the assigned work schedule.
  • Additional Duties as Assigned
    • #HVAC1

lists.text: Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for Residential HVAC Service Technician:
lists.content:
• Customer Satisfaction: Provide clear explanations and educate customers about their HVAC systems, offering preventive maintenance tips and energy-saving recommendations. Maintain customer satisfaction rate through post-service surveys and feedback. Strive to exceed customer expectations and resolve any concerns promptly.
  • First-Time Fix Rate: Achieve a best-in-class first-time fix rate by accurately diagnosing issues, arriving fully prepared with necessary tools and parts, and effectively completing repairs during the initial service call.
  • Response Time: Respond to service requests within Sila's defined time frame. Timely response ensures customer comfort and builds trust.
  • Service Revenue Generation: Diagnose and troubleshoot HVAC equipment issues, recommending appropriate solutions and discussing options with customers. Consistently meet or exceed monthly service revenue targets, contributing to the company's financial growth and success. Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling additional services, products, or maintenance plans to customers during service visits.
  • Service Agreement Enrollment: Successfully enroll customers in Sila’s service agreements, promoting long-term customer relationships and recurring revenue.
  • Productivity and Utilization: Maintain a high level of productivity by efficiently managing work orders, minimizing downtime, and maximizing billable hours.
  • Technical Excellence: Perform routine maintenance, inspections, and repairs on residential HVAC systems to ensure optimal performance and efficiency. Demonstrate continuous improvement in technical skills and knowledge through training, certifications, and staying updated on industry best practices.
  • Inventory Management: Keep track of service vehicle inventory and parts stock, ensuring accuracy and minimizing unnecessary expenses due to missing or overstocked items.
  • Safety Adherence: Maintain a perfect safety record by following all safety protocols and guidelines. Ensure zero safety incidents or accidents within the performance period.
  • Documentation Accuracy: Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of service calls, work performed, and parts used in the Service Titan platform.
  • Team Collaboration: Collaborate effectively with team members, sharing knowledge and assisting colleagues as needed. Strive to maintain a positive team dynamic and contribute to a supportive work environment.
  • Professionalism and Communication: Uphold professional communication and appearance at all times when interacting with customers.
  • Attendance and Punctuality: Maintain a consistent record of punctuality and attendance, arriving at scheduled appointments on time and adhering to the assigned work schedule.
  • Additional Duties as Assigned

lists.text: We don't just offer jobs—we build careers. Here’s why you’ll love being part of our team:
lists.content:
• Industry-Leading weekly Compensation: We believe in rewarding excellence. Our Electricians are amongst the best paid in the area!
  • Fully Stocked Warehouse & Parts Runners: We ensure you have the tools and support you need to excel, with a fully stocked warehouse and parts runners at your service.
  • Clean Fully Stocked Truck: Drive in style with a clean, fully stocked TAKE-HOME truck that’s ready for any job.
  • Comprehensive Health Benefits: We offer affordable, high-quality health, dental, and vision insurance to keep you and your family covered.
  • PTO: We believe in the importance of rest and relaxation, so you start earning paid time off from your first day.
  • 401(k) Plan with Company Match: Secure your future with our competitive 401(k) plan, including a generous company match.
  • Parental Leave: We support our team members through all stages of life, including offering parental leave for new parents.
  • Training and Development Opportunities: We’re committed to your professional growth with training at our new Service Professionals Academy & Resources Center!
  • Yearly Performance Reviews: We believe in continuous improvement and offer yearly performance reviews to ensure you’re on track and rewarded for your hard work.

lists.text: In this role, you’ll be responsible for:
lists.content:
• Troubleshooting, diagnosing, and repairing electrical issues in a residential environment
  • Installing electrical equipment such as generators, panels, and car chargers
  • Updating miscellaneous wiring, switches, lighting, outlets, and performing service upgrades
  • Evaluating homes and offices for electrical safety and make safety recommendations to customer as needed.
  • Maintaining proper stock, parts, tools, and safety equipment in the vehicle
  • Traveling to job sites in your service area, and working with dispatchers to ensure the schedule is maintained and delays are properly communicated to the customer

• 4 or more years of Residential Electrical Experience
  • Generac generator experience a plus.
  • Familiarity with the Nexstar Service System is a plus.
  • Proficiency in using Service Titan or similar field management software a plus.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to diagnose technical issues accurately.
  • Strong communication skills to interact with customers professionally and courteously.
  • Dedication to safety, adhering to safety guidelines and promoting a safe work environment.
    • #Ele1

lists.text: We don't just offer jobs—we build careers. Here’s why you’ll love being part of our team:
lists.content:
• Industry-Leading Compensation: We believe in rewarding excellence. Our technicians earn six-figures!
  • Fully Stocked Warehouse & Parts Runners: We ensure you have the tools and support you need to excel, with a fully stocked warehouse and parts runners at your service.
  • New Clean Fully Stocked Truck: Drive in style with a new, clean, fully stocked truck that’s ready for any job.
  • Comprehensive Health Benefits: We offer affordable, high-quality health, dental, and vision insurance to keep you and your family covered.
  • Paid Time Off
  • 401(k) Plan with Profit sharing: Secure your future with our competitive 401(k) plan, including generous profit sharing.
  • Parental Leave: We support our team members through all stages of life, including offering parental leave for new parents.
  • Tool and Boot Allowance: We provide a tool account as well as a boot allowance up to $125 per year.
  • Training and Development Opportunities: We’re committed to your professional growth with training at our Service Professions Academy & Resource Center!
  • Yearly Performance Reviews: We believe in continuous improvement and offer yearly performance reviews to ensure you’re on track and rewarded for your hard work.

lists.text: In this role, you'll be responsible for:
lists.content:
• Following the Nexstar whole home electrical inspection process
  • Troubleshooting, diagnosing, installing and repairing electrical components in a residential environment
  • Providing excellent customer service
  • Maintaining proper stock, parts, tools, and safety equipment in the vehicle
  • Traveling to job sites in your service area, and work with dispatchers to ensure the schedule is maintained and delays are properly communicated to the customer
  • Obtaining customer authorization/signature for payment (or financing) at the completion of the job
  • Meeting predetermined targets and sales goals
  • Assisting customers in evaluating repair vs. replace options
  • Assisting in generating and scheduling replacement consultations (as indicated)
  • Meeting or exceeding performance minimum standards

• 4 or more years of Residential Electrical Experience
  • Generac generator experience a plus.
  • Familiarity with the Nexstar Service System is a plus.
  • Proficiency in using Service Titan or similar service management software a plus.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to diagnose technical issues accurately.
  • Strong communication skills to interact with customers professionally and courteously.
  • Dedication to safety, adhering to safety guidelines and promoting a safe work environment.

As our plumbing division continues to grow, we're looking for an experienced Residential Service Plumber to join our team. If you enjoy diagnosing problems, delivering quality workmanship, and building trust with homeowners, you'll find a rewarding career with Triangle.

  • Perform drain and water system diagnostics as needed.

  • Ensure all work complies with applicable plumbing codes, safety standards, and company quality expectations.

  • Accurately document work performed and complete service reports using company software.

  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment while respecting customers' homes.

  • Communicate professionally with homeowners and provide exceptional customer service throughout every service call.

  • Collaborate with dispatch and team members to complete jobs efficiently and exceed customer expectations.

  • Participate in ongoing technical and safety training to stay current with industry best practices.

Qualifications

  • Previous residential plumbing service experience required.

  • Strong troubleshooting and diagnostic skills.

  • Experience servicing and installing residential plumbing systems and fixtures.

  • Knowledge of residential plumbing codes, materials, and best practices.

  • Ability to explain technical information clearly and professionally to homeowners.

  • Excellent customer service and communication skills.

  • Valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record.

  • Journeyman plumbing license or equivalent experience preferred.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means providing homeowners with honest recommendations, delivering high-quality repairs and installations, resolving plumbing issues efficiently, and helping Triangle continue to build lasting customer relationships through exceptional service and craftsmanship.

jobs.description: Drain Technician Astacio Plumbing, Heating, Cooling & Electrical | Norwalk, CT A backed-up drain or sewer-line problem can bring an entire household to a standstill. Homeowners need a technician who can respond quickly, diagnose the issue accurately, and provide a dependable solution. At Astacio Plumbing, Heating, Cooling & Electrical, we’re looking for a skilled and customer-focused Drain Technician to join our team in Norwalk, CT. You’ll complete residential drain-cleaning service calls, operate professional cable and jetting equipment, perform camera inspections, and help homeowners understand the best solutions for their plumbing systems. This is an opportunity to build a long-term career with a growing home services company that provides steady work, ongoing training, professional equipment, and room to advance. If you enjoy solving problems, working directly with customers, and being rewarded for delivering great service, we want to meet you. What You’ll Do Complete residential drain-cleaning, cable, and hydro-jetting work during in-home service calls. Diagnose and clear stoppages using small- and large-sized drain-cleaning machines. Perform camera inspections for mainline stoppages and other sewer or drain concerns. Identify drain and sewer problems and recommend appropriate solutions. Clearly explain diagnosed issues, service options, and the features and benefits of each recommendation. Obtain customer approval before beginning any work. Identify opportunities to recommend additional products or services that benefit the customer. Remove and reset toilets and P-traps when required to complete drain-cleaning work. Complete accurate service notes, estimates, photos, and customer documentation. Maintain assigned truck inventory and restock parts to required minimum levels. Operate all equipment safely and wear required personal protective equipment. Maintain a clean work area and protect customers’ homes throughout each service call. Ability to operate small- and large-sized drain-cleaning equipment safely. Experience with cable machines, hydro-jetting equipment, and sewer cameras preferred. Basic understanding of residential plumbing and drain systems. Ability to remove and reset toilets and P-traps. Strong diagnostic and problem-solving skills. Comfortable discussing service options and recommending additional solutions when appropriate. Professional communication and customer service skills. Ability to remain calm and courteous when assisting frustrated customers. Strong attention to safety, cleanliness, and detail. Reliable attendance and the ability to work independently. Comfortable using tablets, mobile applications, and field service software. Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record. Ability to perform physical work in basements, crawl spaces, bathrooms, and outdoor conditions. 401K with a company match

Company-paid training and certification opportunities
