Position Overview
The Site Foreman is responsible for overseeing daily underground drain and sewer field operations while leading crews safely and efficiently in the field. This role serves as the direct connection between field crews and Operations management, ensuring projects are completed on time, on budget, and to Delco Storm & Sewer quality standards.
This is a hands-on role requiring both leadership and field involvement.
What You’ll Do
Field Operations & Safety
Oversee daily field operations including sewer repair, drain cleaning, jetting, CCTV inspections, excavation, and underground utility work
Ensure all work is completed safely, efficiently, and according to project specifications
Direct the operation and maintenance of Vactor trucks, jetters, CCTV equipment, excavation equipment, and related machinery
Enforce OSHA safety standards including trenching/shoring and confined space requirements
Conduct pre-job safety meetings and toolbox talks
Ensure crews, materials, and equipment are prepared before work begins
Proactively identify and resolve job site issues to prevent delays
Crew Leadership & Development
Lead and mentor field crews through hands-on coaching and support
Delegate daily responsibilities and manage crew productivity
Maintain accountability and professionalism across the job site
Reinforce company safety standards and quality expectations
Support employee development and training initiatives including OSHA, CDL, PACP/LACP/MACP certifications, and equipment training
Communicate staffing, training, or performance concerns to Operations leadership
Quality Control & Customer Communication
Ensure all work meets Delco Storm & Sewer quality standards before leaving the site
Serve as the primary on-site representative for customers, property managers, municipalities, and contractors
Communicate project timelines, findings, and unforeseen conditions professionally and clearly
Identify scope changes, safety concerns, and field issues and escalate appropriately
Documentation & Reporting
Complete daily job reports, timesheets, work orders, and inspection documentation accurately
Track material usage, equipment hours, and job progress
Maintain safety records and compliance documentation
Report equipment maintenance concerns before they become operational issues
What We’re Looking For
Experience in underground utilities, sewer, stormwater, excavation, or civil construction required
Prior Foreman, Crew Lead, or supervisory experience preferred
Strong understanding of sewer cleaning, jetting, CCTV inspections, and underground repair methods
Experience with Vactor trucks and related equipment strongly preferred
Thorough understanding of OSHA trenching/shoring and confined space safety requirements
OSHA-10 certification required; OSHA-30 preferred
Strong leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills
Ability to lead crews in fast-paced field environments
CDL license preferred
Clean driving record required
Physical & Work Requirements
Ability to work outdoors in all weather conditions
Ability to work around heavy equipment, trenches, confined spaces, and underground infrastructure
Ability to perform physically demanding work including lifting, digging, and climbing
Flexible schedule with availability for emergency response work when needed
Travel between job sites throughout the service area required
Why Delco Storm & Sewer?
At Delco Storm & Sewer, we’re building a team of hardworking professionals who take pride in quality work, safety, and accountability.
We’re looking for leaders who want to help build a strong field culture, develop crews, and grow with a company that values hands-on leadership and operational excellence.
Apply today to join a growing underground utility and sewer contractor where your leadership makes a direct impact every day.

jobs.title: Underground Utility Technician
jobs.description: Underground Utility Technician Delco Storm & Sewer | Lansdowne, PA Underground utility work takes skill, judgment, and a willingness to take ownership of difficult jobs. At Delco Storm & Sewer, our technicians solve the problems homeowners cannot afford to ignore—from failed sewer laterals to damaged water services. We’re looking for an Underground Utility Technician to install and repair residential sewer laterals and water service lines using both traditional trenching and trenchless methods. You’ll work with specialized equipment, learn advanced repair techniques, and be part of a team that values safe work, quality execution, and doing the job right the first time. This is an opportunity to build a long-term career in a specialized trade with steady demand and clear room to grow. If you enjoy hands-on work, solving problems in the field, and seeing the results of your effort at the end of each day, Delco Storm & Sewer may be the right place for your next move. What You’ll Do Install, repair, and replace residential sewer laterals and water service lines. Perform work using both open-trench and trenchless repair methods. Excavate, expose, and prepare underground piping for repair or replacement. Assist with pipe bursting, lining, boring, and other trenchless applications. Install sewer, water, drainage, and related underground piping. Identify utility conflicts, site conditions, and access concerns before work begins. Operate excavation, compaction, cutting, pumping, and trenchless equipment safely. Set grades, make pipe connections, test completed systems, and confirm proper operation. Restore excavated areas, including backfilling, compaction, and site cleanup. Protect customer property and maintain a clean, organized, and professional jobsite. Follow trench safety, confined-space, utility-marking, and personal protective equipment requirements. Maintain assigned tools, equipment, materials, and vehicle inventory. Communicate job progress, material needs, and unexpected field conditions promptly. Work closely with crew leaders, plumbers, equipment operators, and office staff. Participate in required safety meetings, technical training, and company meetings. What We’re Looking For Previous underground utility, sewer, water service, excavation, plumbing, or construction experience preferred. Experience with sewer laterals, water services, trenching, or trenchless repair methods is a plus. Strong mechanical ability and comfort working with tools and equipment. Ability to read basic measurements, follow grades, and understand jobsite layouts. Commitment to safe work practices and proper trench protection. Dependable attendance, strong work ethic, and attention to detail. Ability to follow direction and work effectively as part of a crew. Professional communication and respect for customers and their property. Ability to perform demanding physical work in varying weather and site conditions. Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record. CDL, equipment operation experience, or plumbing knowledge is a plus. Why Work at Delco Storm & Sewer? Competitive compensation based on experience Steady, year-round demand for essential services Hands-on training in both trench and trenchless methods Exposure to specialized equipment and repair technology Opportunities to advance into crew leadership, equipment operation, or plumbing roles Company-provided tools and equipment Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance 401(k) with Company Match Ongoing Safety and Technical Training Supportive, Team-Oriented Work Environment The opportunity to develop a specialized and valuable trade skill What Success Looks Like Success in this role means completing safe, durable underground repairs while protecting customers’ homes and property. You’ll contribute to efficient jobsites, communicate clearly with your crew, and help Delco Storm & Sewer deliver reliable solutions that homeowners can depend on.

JSP Home Services | Kingston, NY
Keep the Team Moving and Build a Career in Home Services
Great field service depends on more than skilled technicians. It takes an organized warehouse, accurate inventory, and dependable team members who make sure the right parts and equipment reach the right job at the right time.
At JSP Home Services, we’re looking for a reliable and motivated Warehouse Runner to support our HVAC, plumbing, and electrical teams. You’ll help receive and organize materials, prepare equipment for upcoming jobs, deliver parts to technicians in the field, and keep the warehouse and company vehicles operating efficiently.
This is a hands-on opportunity to join an established home services company, learn how field operations work, and build experience that can lead to additional warehouse, logistics, operations, or skilled-trade opportunities.
If you take pride in staying organized, helping others, and keeping work moving, JSP Home Services may be the right place to grow your career.
What You’ll Do
Deliver parts, tools, equipment, and materials to technicians and installation crews.
Pick up materials from suppliers and transport them safely to the warehouse or jobsite.
Receive, inspect, label, and organize incoming inventory.
Pull and stage equipment and materials for scheduled service and installation jobs.
Help load and unload company vehicles and supplier deliveries.
Maintain accurate inventory counts and report damaged, missing, or low-stock items.
Keep the warehouse, loading areas, and storage spaces clean and organized.
Assist with restocking service and installation vehicles.
Verify that job materials are complete and ready before crews leave for the field.
Maintain delivery records, receipts, and inventory documentation.
Communicate urgent material needs and delivery updates to warehouse and operations leaders.
Operate company vehicles and warehouse equipment safely.
Follow all company safety procedures and policies.
Assist with additional warehouse and operational tasks as needed.
What We’re Looking For
Previous warehouse, delivery, inventory, construction, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, or material-handling experience preferred.
Reliable attendance, punctuality, and a strong work ethic.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
Ability to work independently and respond to changing priorities.
Professional communication and teamwork skills.
Basic computer and mobile-device proficiency.
Ability to safely lift, carry, load, and move equipment and materials.
Comfortable working in a warehouse and driving throughout the local service area.
Forklift or warehouse equipment experience is a plus.
Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record required.

Competitive hourly compensation
